<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_AT"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_AT

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_AT">// AArch32_AT() // ============ //
Perform address translation as per AT instructions. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_AT_4">AArch32_AT(vaddress : bits(32), stage_in
:</span>
[TranslationStage](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TranslationStage),
el : bits(2), ataccess :
[ATAccess](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_ATAccess))
begin var stage :
[TranslationStage](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TranslationStage)
= stage_in; var ss :
[SecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SecurityState);
var regime :
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime);
var eae : boolean; // ATS1Hx instructions if el ==
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)
then regime =
[Regime_EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL2);
eae = TRUE; ss =
[SS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_NonSecure);
// ATS1Cxx instructions elsif stage ==
[TranslationStage_1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TranslationStage_1)
\|\| (stage ==
[TranslationStage_12](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TranslationStage_12)
&&
\![HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)))
then stage =
[TranslationStage_1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TranslationStage_1);
ss =
[SecurityStateAtEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SecurityStateAtEL_1)([PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL);
regime = if ss ==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&&
[ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then
[Regime_EL30](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL30)
else
[Regime_EL10](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL10);
eae = TTBCR().EAE == '1'; // ATS12NSOxx instructions else regime =
[Regime_EL10](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL10);
eae = (if
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
&&
[ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then TTBCR_NS().EAE == '1' else TTBCR().EAE == '1'); ss =
[SS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_NonSecure);
end; var addrdesc :
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor);
var sdftype :
[SDFType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SDFType);
let aligned : boolean = TRUE; var supersection : bit = '0'; let accdesc
:
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor)
=
[CreateAccDescAT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CreateAccDescAT_3)(ss,
el, ataccess); // Prepare fault fields in case a fault is detected var
fault :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
=
[NoFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_NoFault_2)(accdesc,
ZeroExtend{64}(vaddress)); if eae then (fault, addrdesc) =
[AArch32_S1TranslateLD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_S1TranslateLD_5)(fault,
regime, vaddress, aligned, accdesc); else (fault, addrdesc, sdftype) =
[AArch32_S1TranslateSD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_S1TranslateSD_5)(fault,
regime, vaddress, aligned, accdesc); supersection = if sdftype ==
[SDFType_Supersection](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SDFType_Supersection)
then '1' else '0'; end; // ATS12NSOxx instructions if stage ==
[TranslationStage_12](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TranslationStage_12)
&& fault.statuscode ==
[Fault_None](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_None)
then (fault, addrdesc) =
[AArch32_S2Translate](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_S2Translate_4)(fault,
addrdesc, aligned, accdesc); end; if fault.statuscode !=
[Fault_None](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_None)
then // Take exception on External abort or when a fault occurs on
translation table walk if
[IsExternalAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalAbort_1)(fault)
\|\|
([PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL
==
[EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1)
&&
[EL2Enabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EL2Enabled_0)()
&& fault.s2fs1walk) then PAR() = ARBITRARY : bits(64);
[AArch32_Abort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_Abort_1)(fault);
end; end; addrdesc.fault = fault; if (eae \|\| (stage ==
[TranslationStage_12](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TranslationStage_12)
&& (HCR().VM == '1' \|\| HCR().DC == '1')) \|\| (stage ==
[TranslationStage_1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TranslationStage_1)
&& el !=
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)
&&
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL
==
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)))
then
[AArch32_EncodePARLD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_EncodePARLD_2)(addrdesc,
ss); else
[AArch32_EncodePARSD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_EncodePARSD_3)(addrdesc,
supersection, ss); end; return; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_EncodePARLD"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_EncodePARLD

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_EncodePARLD">// AArch32_EncodePARLD() //
===================== // Returns 64-bit format PAR on address
translation instruction. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_EncodePARLD_2">AArch32_EncodePARLD(addrdesc
:</span>
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor),
ss :
[SecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SecurityState))
begin PAR()\[63:0\] = Zeros{64}; if
\![IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(addrdesc)
then var ns : bit; if ss ==
[SS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_NonSecure)
then ns = ARBITRARY : bit; elsif addrdesc.paddress.paspace ==
[PAS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Secure)
then ns = '0'; else ns = '1'; end; PAR().F = '0'; PAR().SH =
[ReportedPARShareability](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ReportedPARShareability_1)([PAREncodeShareability](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PAREncodeShareability_1)(addrdesc.memattrs));
PAR().NS = ns; PAR()\[10\] = ImpDefBit("Non-Faulting PAR"); // IMPDEF
PAR().LPAE = '1'; PAR().PA = addrdesc.paddress.address\[39:12\];
PAR().ATTR =
[ReportedPARAttrs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ReportedPARAttrs_1)([EncodePARAttrs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EncodePARAttrs_1)(addrdesc.memattrs));
else PAR().F = '1'; PAR().FST =
[AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD_1)(addrdesc.fault);
PAR().S2WLK = if addrdesc.fault.s2fs1walk then '1' else '0';
PAR().FSTAGE = if addrdesc.fault.secondstage then '1' else '0';
PAR().LPAE = '1'; PAR()\[63:48\] = ImpDefBits{16}("Faulting PAR"); //
IMPDEF end; return; end;

</div>

<div class="ps">

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_EncodePARSD"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_EncodePARSD

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_EncodePARSD">// AArch32_EncodePARSD() //
===================== // Returns 32-bit format PAR on address
translation instruction. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_EncodePARSD_3">AArch32_EncodePARSD(addrdesc_in
:</span>
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor),
supersection : bit, ss :
[SecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SecurityState))
begin PAR()\[31:0\] = Zeros{32}; var addrdesc :
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor)
= addrdesc_in; if
\![IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(addrdesc)
then if (addrdesc.memattrs.memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device)
\|\| (addrdesc.memattrs.inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
&& addrdesc.memattrs.outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)))
then addrdesc.memattrs.shareability =
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH);
end; var ns : bit; if ss ==
[SS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_NonSecure)
then ns = ARBITRARY : bit; elsif addrdesc.paddress.paspace ==
[PAS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Secure)
then ns = '0'; else ns = '1'; end; let sh : bits(2) = (if
addrdesc.memattrs.shareability !=
[Shareability_NSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_NSH)
then '01' else '00'); PAR().F = '0'; PAR().SS = supersection;
PAR().Outer =
[AArch32_ReportedOuterAttrs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_ReportedOuterAttrs_1)([AArch32_PAROuterAttrs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_PAROuterAttrs_1)(addrdesc.memattrs));
PAR().Inner =
[AArch32_ReportedInnerAttrs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_ReportedInnerAttrs_1)([AArch32_PARInnerAttrs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_PARInnerAttrs_1)(addrdesc.memattrs));
PAR().SH =
[ReportedPARShareability](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ReportedPARShareability_1)(sh);
PAR()\[8\] = ImpDefBit("Non-Faulting PAR"); // IMPDEF PAR().NS = ns;
PAR().NOS = if addrdesc.memattrs.shareability ==
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH)
then '0' else '1'; PAR().LPAE = '0'; PAR().PA =
addrdesc.paddress.address\[39:12\]; else PAR().F = '1'; PAR().FST =
[AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD_1)(addrdesc.fault);
PAR().LPAE = '0'; PAR()\[31:16\] = ImpDefBits{16}("Faulting PAR"); //
IMPDEF end; return; end;

</div>

<div class="ps">

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD">//
AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD() // ========================== // Fault status
field decoding of 64-bit PAR func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD_1">AArch32_PARFaultStatusLD(fault
:</span>
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord))
=\> bits(6) begin var syndrome : bits(6); if fault.statuscode ==
[Fault_Domain](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Domain)
then // Report Domain fault assert fault.level IN {1,2}; syndrome\[1:0\]
= if fault.level == 1 then '01' else '10'; syndrome\[5:2\] = '1111';
else syndrome =
[EncodeLDFSC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EncodeLDFSC_2)(fault.statuscode,
fault.level); end; return syndrome; end;

</div>

<div class="ps">

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD">//
AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD() // ========================== // Fault status
field decoding of 32-bit PAR. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD_1">AArch32_PARFaultStatusSD(fault
:</span>
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord))
=\> bits(6) begin var syndrome : bits(6); syndrome\[5\] = if
[IsExternalAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalAbort_1)(fault)
then fault.extflag else '0'; syndrome\[4:0\] =
[EncodeSDFSC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EncodeSDFSC_2)(fault.statuscode,
fault.level); return syndrome; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PARInnerAttrs"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_PARInnerAttrs

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PARInnerAttrs">// AArch32_PARInnerAttrs()
// ======================= // Convert orthogonal attributes and hints to
32-bit PAR Inner field. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_PARInnerAttrs_1">AArch32_PARInnerAttrs(memattrs
:</span>
[MemoryAttributes](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemoryAttributes))
=\> bits(3) begin var result : bits(3); if memattrs.memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device)
then if memattrs.device ==
[DeviceType_nGnRnE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_DeviceType_nGnRnE)
then result = '001'; // Non-cacheable elsif memattrs.device ==
[DeviceType_nGnRE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_DeviceType_nGnRE)
then result = '011'; // Non-cacheable end; else let inner :
[MemAttrHints](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemAttrHints)
= memattrs.inner; if inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
then result = '000'; // Non-cacheable elsif inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB)
&& inner.hints\[0\] == '1' then result = '101'; // Write-Back,
Write-Allocate elsif inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WT)
then result = '110'; // Write-Through elsif inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB)
&& inner.hints\[0\] == '0' then result = '111'; // Write-Back, no
Write-Allocate end; end; return result; end;

</div>

<div class="ps">

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PAROuterAttrs"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/at/AArch32_PAROuterAttrs

<span id="aarch32.at.AArch32_PAROuterAttrs">// AArch32_PAROuterAttrs()
// ======================= // Convert orthogonal attributes and hints to
32-bit PAR Outer field. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_PAROuterAttrs_1">AArch32_PAROuterAttrs(memattrs
:</span>
[MemoryAttributes](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemoryAttributes))
=\> bits(2) begin var result : bits(2); if memattrs.memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device)
then result = ARBITRARY : bits(2); else let outer :
[MemAttrHints](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemAttrHints)
= memattrs.outer; if outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
then result = '00'; // Non-cacheable elsif outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB)
&& outer.hints\[0\] == '1' then result = '01'; // Write-Back,
Write-Allocate elsif outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WT)
&& outer.hints\[0\] == '0' then result = '10'; // Write-Through, no
Write-Allocate elsif outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB)
&& outer.hints\[0\] == '0' then result = '11'; // Write-Back, no
Write-Allocate end; end; return result; end;

</div>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/dc/AArch32_DC

<span id="aarch32.dc.AArch32_DC">// AArch32_DC() // ============ //
Perform Data Cache Operation. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_DC_3">AArch32_DC(regval : bits(32), cacheop

3; // Word or doubleword var bottom = cmpbottom; let select : integer{}

(DBGWCR(n).BAS\[select\] != '0'); var mask : integer{} =
UInt(DBGWCR(n).MASK); // If DBGWCR(n).MASK is a nonzero value and

is set to a reserved value, the behavior is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE.
if mask \> 0 && mask \<= 2 then var c :
[Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint);
var unpred_mask : integer; (c, unpred_mask) =
[ConstrainUnpredictableInteger](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableInteger_3)(3,
31,
[Unpredictable_RESWPMASK](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_RESWPMASK));
assert c IN
{[Constraint_DISABLED](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_DISABLED),
[Constraint_NONE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_NONE),
[Constraint_UNKNOWN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_UNKNOWN)};

[Constraint_DISABLED](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_DISABLED)
=\> return FALSE; // Disabled when
[Constraint_NONE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_NONE)
=\> mask = 0; // No masking // Otherwise the value returned by
ConstrainUnpredictableInteger is a not-reserved value otherwise =\> mask
= unpred_mask as integer{3..31}; end; end; let cmpmsb : integer{} =
dbgtop; let cmplsb : integer{} = if mask \> bottom then mask else
bottom; let bottombit : integer{} = bottom; var WVR_match : boolean =
(vaddress\[cmpmsb:cmplsb\] == DBGWVR(n)\[cmpmsb:cmplsb\]); if mask \>
bottom then // If masked bits of DBGWVR(n) are not zero, the behavior is

<span id="aarch32.functions.system.AArch32_WriteModeByInstr"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/functions/system/AArch32_WriteModeByInstr

<span id="aarch32.functions.system.AArch32_WriteModeByInstr">//
AArch32_WriteModeByInstr() // ========================== // Function for
dealing with writes to PSTATE.M from an AArch32 instruction, and
ensuring that // illegal state changes are correctly flagged in
PSTATE.IL. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_WriteModeByInstr_1">AArch32_WriteModeByInstr(mode
: bits(5)) begin var (valid,el) : (boolean, bits(2)) =</span>
[ELFromM32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELFromM32_1)(mode);
// 'valid' is set to FALSE if' mode' is invalid for this implementation
or the current value // of SCR.NS/SCR_EL3.NS. Additionally, it is
illegal for an instruction to write 'mode' to // PSTATE.EL if it would
result in any of: // \* A change to a mode that would cause entry to a
higher Exception level. if UInt(el) \>
UInt([PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL)
then valid = FALSE; end; // \* A change to or from Hyp mode. if
([PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).M
==
[M32_Hyp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Hyp)
\|\| mode ==
[M32_Hyp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Hyp))
&&
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).M
!= mode then valid = FALSE; end; // \* When EL2 is implemented, the
value of HCR.TGE is '1', a change to a Non-secure EL1 mode. if
([PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).M
==
[M32_Monitor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Monitor)
&&
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2))
&& el ==
[EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1)
&& SCR().NS == '1' && HCR().TGE == '1') then valid = FALSE; end; if
!valid then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).IL
= '1'; else
[AArch32_WriteMode](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_WriteMode_1)(mode);
end; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch32.functions.system.BadMode">// BadMode() // =========
readonly func</span> <span id="func_BadMode_1">BadMode(mode : bits(5))
=\> boolean begin // Return TRUE if 'mode' encodes a mode that is not
valid for this implementation var valid : boolean; case mode of
when</span>
[M32_Monitor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Monitor)
=\> valid =
[HaveAArch32EL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveAArch32EL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3));
when
[M32_Hyp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Hyp)
=\> valid =
[HaveAArch32EL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveAArch32EL_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2));
when
[M32_FIQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_FIQ),
[M32_IRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_IRQ),
[M32_Svc](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Svc),
[M32_Abort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Abort),
[M32_Undef](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Undef),
[M32_System](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_System)
=\> // If EL3 is implemented and using AArch32, then these modes are EL3
modes in Secure // state, and EL1 modes in Non-secure state. If EL3 is
not implemented or is using // AArch64, then these modes are EL1 modes.
// Therefore it is sufficient to test this implementation supports EL1
using AArch32 valid =
[HaveAArch32EL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveAArch32EL_1)([EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1));
when
[M32_User](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_User)
=\> valid =
[HaveAArch32EL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveAArch32EL_1)([EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0));
otherwise =\> valid = FALSE; // Passed an illegal mode value end; return
!valid; end;

<span id="aarch32.functions.system.BankedRegisterAccessValid">//

other than the SPSRs that are invalid. This includes ELR_hyp accesses.
func</span>

: bits(5), mode : bits(5)) =\> (boolean,</span>

begin var valid : boolean = TRUE; var c :
[Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint)
=

when '00101' =\> // SP_usr banked_unpred = mode ==

when '00110' =\> // LR_usr banked_unpred = mode IN

when '010xx', '0110x', '01110' =\> // R8_fiq to R12_fiq, SP_fiq, LR_fiq
banked_unpred = mode ==
[M32_FIQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_FIQ);
when '1000x' =\> // LR_irq, SP_irq banked_unpred = mode ==
[M32_IRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_IRQ);
when '1001x' =\> // LR_svc, SP_svc banked_unpred = mode ==

when '1010x' =\> // LR_abt, SP_abt banked_unpred = mode ==
[M32_Abort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Abort);
when '1011x' =\> // LR_und, SP_und banked_unpred = mode ==
[M32_Undef](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Undef);
when '1110x' =\> // LR_mon, SP_mon banked_unpred =
(\![HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
\|\|
[CurrentSecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CurrentSecurityState_0)()
!=
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
\|\| mode ==
[M32_Monitor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Monitor));
when '11110' =\> // ELR_hyp, only from Monitor or Hyp mode banked_unpred
=
\![HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2))
\|\| ! mode IN
{[M32_Monitor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Monitor),[M32_Hyp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Hyp)};
when '11111' =\> // SP_hyp, only from Monitor mode banked_unpred =
\![HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2))
\|\| mode !=
[M32_Monitor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_M32_Monitor);

end; if banked_unpred then valid = FALSE; c =

{[Constraint_UNDEF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_UNDEF),

<span id="aarch32.functions.system.CPSRWriteByInstr"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/functions/system/CPSRWriteByInstr

<span id="aarch32.functions.system.CPSRWriteByInstr">//
CPSRWriteByInstr() // ================== // Update
PSTATE.\[N,Z,C,V,Q,GR,E,A,I,F,M\] from a CPSR value written by an MSR
instruction. func</span>
<span id="func_CPSRWriteByInstr_2">CPSRWriteByInstr(value : bits(32),
bytemask : bits(4)) begin let privileged : boolean =</span>
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL
!=
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0);
// PSTATE.\[A,I,F,M\] are not writable at EL0 // Write PSTATE from
'value', ignoring bytes masked by 'bytemask' if bytemask\[3\] == '1'
then PSTATE.\[N,Z,C,V,Q\] = value\[31:27\]; // Bits \[26:24\] are
ignored end; if bytemask\[2\] == '1' then if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SSBS) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).SSBS
= value\[23\]; end; if privileged then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PAN
= value\[22\]; end; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_DIT) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).DIT
= value\[21\]; end; // Bit \[20\] is RES0
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).GE
= value\[19:16\]; end; if bytemask\[1\] == '1' then // Bits \[15:10\]
are RES0
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).E
= value\[9\]; // PSTATE.E is writable at EL0 if privileged then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).A
= value\[8\]; end; end; if bytemask\[0\] == '1' then if privileged then
PSTATE.\[I,F\] = value\[7:6\]; // Bit \[5\] is RES0 //
AArch32_WriteModeByInstr() sets PSTATE.IL to 1 if this is an illegal
mode change.
[AArch32_WriteModeByInstr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_WriteModeByInstr_1)(value\[4:0\]);
end; end; return; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch32.translation.attrs.AArch32_DefaultTEXDecode">//
AArch32_DefaultTEXDecode() // ========================== // Apply
short-descriptor format memory region attributes, without TEX remap
func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_DefaultTEXDecode_4">AArch32_DefaultTEXDecode(TEX_in
: bits(3), c_in : bit, b_in : bit, s : bit) =\></span>
[MemoryAttributes](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemoryAttributes)
begin var memattrs :
[MemoryAttributes](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemoryAttributes);
var TEX : bits(3) = TEX_in; var c : bit = c_in; var b : bit = b_in; //
Reserved values map to allocated values if (TEX == '001' && c::b ==
'01') \|\| (TEX == '010' && c::b != '00') \|\| TEX == '011' then var
texcb : bits(5); (-, texcb) =
ConstrainUnpredictableBits{5}([Unpredictable_RESTEXCB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_RESTEXCB));
TEX = texcb\[4:2\]; c = texcb\[1\]; b = texcb\[0\]; end; // Distinction
between Inner Shareable and Outer Shareable is not supported in this
format // A memory region is either Non-shareable or Outer Shareable
case TEX::c::b of when '00000' =\> // Device-nGnRnE memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device);
memattrs.device =
[DeviceType_nGnRnE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_DeviceType_nGnRnE);
memattrs.shareability =
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH);
when '00001', '01000' =\> // Device-nGnRE memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device);
memattrs.device =
[DeviceType_nGnRE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_DeviceType_nGnRE);
memattrs.shareability =
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH);
when '00010' =\> // Write-through Read allocate memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Normal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Normal);
memattrs.inner.attrs =
[MemAttr_WT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WT);
memattrs.inner.hints =
[MemHint_RA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RA);
memattrs.outer.attrs =
[MemAttr_WT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WT);
memattrs.outer.hints =
[MemHint_RA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RA);
memattrs.shareability = if s == '1' then
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH)
else
[Shareability_NSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_NSH);
when '00011' =\> // Write-back Read allocate memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Normal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Normal);
memattrs.inner.attrs =
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB);
memattrs.inner.hints =
[MemHint_RA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RA);
memattrs.outer.attrs =
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB);
memattrs.outer.hints =
[MemHint_RA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RA);
memattrs.shareability = if s == '1' then
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH)
else
[Shareability_NSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_NSH);
when '00100' =\> // Non-cacheable memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Normal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Normal);
memattrs.inner.attrs =
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC);
memattrs.outer.attrs =
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC);
memattrs.shareability =
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH);
when '00110' =\> memattrs =
ImpDefMemoryAttributes("IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED"); when '00111' =\> //
Write-back Read and Write allocate memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Normal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Normal);
memattrs.inner.attrs =
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB);
memattrs.inner.hints =
[MemHint_RWA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RWA);
memattrs.outer.attrs =
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB);
memattrs.outer.hints =
[MemHint_RWA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RWA);
memattrs.shareability = if s == '1' then
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH)
else
[Shareability_NSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_NSH);
when '1xxxx' =\> // Cacheable, TEX\[1:0\] = Outer attrs, {c,b} = Inner
attrs memattrs.memtype =
[MemType_Normal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Normal);
memattrs.inner =
[DecodeSDFAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_DecodeSDFAttr_1)(c::b);
memattrs.outer =
[DecodeSDFAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_DecodeSDFAttr_1)(TEX\[1:0\]);
if memattrs.inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
&& memattrs.outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
then memattrs.shareability =
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH);
else memattrs.shareability = if s == '1' then
[Shareability_OSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_OSH)
else
[Shareability_NSH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Shareability_NSH);
end; otherwise =\> // Reserved, handled above unreachable; end; // The
Transient hint is not supported in this format memattrs.inner.transient
= FALSE; memattrs.outer.transient = FALSE; memattrs.tags =
[MemTag_Untagged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemTag_Untagged);
if memattrs.inner.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB)
&& memattrs.outer.attrs ==
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB)
then memattrs.xs = '0'; else memattrs.xs = '1'; end; return memattrs;
end;

<span id="aarch32.translation.faults.AArch32_S1LDHasPermissionsFault">//
AArch32_S1LDHasPermissionsFault() // =================================
// Returns whether an access using stage 1 long-descriptor translation
// violates permissions of target memory func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_S1LDHasPermissionsFault_6">AArch32_S1LDHasPermissionsFault(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
walkparams :
[S1TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1TTWParams),
perms :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions),
memtype :
[MemType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemType),
paspace :
[PASpace](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PASpace),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\> boolean begin var r, w, x : bit; var pr, pw : bit; var ur, uw : bit;
var xn : bit; if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then // Apply leaf permissions case perms.ap\[2:1\] of when '00' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','0','0'); // R/W at PL1 only when '01' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','1','1'); // R/W at any PL when '10' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','0','0'); // RO at PL1 only when '11' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','1','0'); // RO at any PL end; // Apply
hierarchical permissions case perms.ap_table of when '00' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ( pr, pw, ur, uw); // No effect when '01' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ( pr, pw,'0','0'); // Privileged access when '10' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ( pr,'0', ur,'0'); // Read-only when '11' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ( pr,'0','0','0'); // Read-only, privileged access end;
xn = perms.xn OR perms.xn_table; let pxn : bit = perms.pxn OR
perms.pxn_table; let ux : bit = ur AND NOT(xn OR (uw AND
walkparams.wxn)); let px : bit = pr AND NOT(xn OR pxn OR (pw AND
walkparams.wxn) OR (uw AND walkparams.uwxn)); if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAN) && accdesc.pan then let pan : bit =
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PAN
AND (ur OR uw); pr = pr AND NOT(pan); pw = pw AND NOT(pan); end; (r,w,x)
= if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then (ur,uw,ux) else (pr,pw,px); // Prevent execution from Non-secure
space by PE in Secure state if SIF is set if accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&& paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure)
then x = x AND NOT(walkparams.sif); end; else // Apply leaf permissions
case perms.ap\[2\] of when '0' =\> (r,w) = ('1','1'); // No effect when
'1' =\> (r,w) = ('1','0'); // Read-only end; // Apply hierarchical
permissions case perms.ap_table\[1\] of when '0' =\> (r,w) = ( r, w );
// No effect when '1' =\> (r,w) = ( r, '0'); // Read-only end; xn =
perms.xn OR perms.xn_table; x = NOT(xn OR (w AND walkparams.wxn)); end;
if accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_IFETCH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IFETCH)
then let constraint :
[Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint)
=
ConstrainUnpredictable([Unpredictable_INSTRDEVICE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_INSTRDEVICE));
if constraint ==
[Constraint_FAULT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_FAULT)
&& memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device)
then return TRUE; else return x == '0'; end; elsif accdesc.acctype IN
{[AccessType_IC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IC),
[AccessType_DC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_DC)}
then return FALSE; elsif accdesc.write then return w == '0'; else return
r == '0'; end; end;

</div>

// Returns whether an access using stage 1 short-descriptor translation
// violates permissions of target memory func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_S1SDHasPermissionsFault_5">AArch32_S1SDHasPermissionsFault(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
perms_in :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions),
memtype :
[MemType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemType),
paspace :
[PASpace](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PASpace),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\> boolean begin var perms :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions)
= perms_in; var pr, pw : bit; var ur, uw : bit; var sctlr : SCTLR_Type;
if regime ==
[Regime_EL30](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL30)
then sctlr = SCTLR_S(); elsif
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
&&
[ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then sctlr = SCTLR_NS(); else sctlr = SCTLR(); end; if sctlr.AFE == '0'
then // Map Reserved encoding '100' if perms.ap == '100' then perms.ap =
ImpDefBits{3}("Reserved short descriptor AP encoding"); end; case
perms.ap of when '000' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('0','0','0','0'); // No
access when '001' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','0','0'); // R/W at PL1
only when '010' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','1','0'); // R/W at PL1, RO
at PL0 when '011' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','1','1'); // R/W at any
PL // '100' is reserved when '101' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) =
('1','0','0','0'); // RO at PL1 only when '110' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) =
('1','0','1','0'); // RO at any PL (deprecated) when '111' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','1','0'); // RO at any PL end; else //
Simplified access permissions model case perms.ap\[2:1\] of when '00'
=\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','0','0'); // R/W at PL1 only when '01' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','1','1'); // R/W at any PL when '10' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','0','0'); // RO at PL1 only when '11' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','1','0'); // RO at any PL end; end; let ux :
bit = ur AND NOT(perms.xn OR (uw AND sctlr.WXN)); let px : bit = pr AND
NOT(perms.xn OR perms.pxn OR (pw AND sctlr.WXN) OR (uw AND sctlr.UWXN));
if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAN) && accdesc.pan then let pan : bit =
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PAN
AND (ur OR uw); pr = pr AND NOT(pan); pw = pw AND NOT(pan); end; var
(r,w,x) : (bit, bit, bit) = if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then (ur,uw,ux) else (pr,pw,px); // Prevent execution from Non-secure
space by PE in Secure state if SIF is set if accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&& paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure)
then x = x AND NOT(if
[ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then SCR().SIF else SCR_EL3().SIF); end; if accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_IFETCH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IFETCH)
then if (memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device)
&&
ConstrainUnpredictable([Unpredictable_INSTRDEVICE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_INSTRDEVICE))
==
[Constraint_FAULT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_FAULT))
then return TRUE; else return x == '0'; end; elsif accdesc.acctype IN
{[AccessType_IC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IC),
[AccessType_DC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_DC)}
then return FALSE; elsif accdesc.write then return w == '0'; else return
r == '0'; end; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch32.translation.faults.AArch32_S2HasPermissionsFault">//
AArch32_S2HasPermissionsFault() // =============================== //
Returns whether stage 2 access violates permissions of target memory
func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_S2HasPermissionsFault_4">AArch32_S2HasPermissionsFault(walkparams
:</span>
[S2TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2TTWParams),

[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions),
memtype :
[MemType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemType),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\> boolean begin let r : bit = perms.s2ap\[0\]; let w : bit =
perms.s2ap\[1\]; var x : bit; var ux : bit; var px : bit; if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_XNX) then case perms.s2xn::perms.s2xnx of when
'00' =\> (px, ux) = ( r, r ); when '01' =\> (px, ux) = ('0', r ); when
'10' =\> (px, ux) = ('0', '0'); when '11' =\> (px, ux) = ( r, '0'); end;
x = if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then ux else px; else x = r AND NOT(perms.s2xn); end; if accdesc.acctype
==
[AccessType_TTW](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_TTW)
then return (walkparams.ptw == '1' && memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device))
\|\| r == '0'; elsif accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_IFETCH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IFETCH)
then let constraint :
[Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint)
=
ConstrainUnpredictable([Unpredictable_INSTRDEVICE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_INSTRDEVICE));
return (constraint ==
[Constraint_FAULT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_FAULT)
&& memtype ==
[MemType_Device](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemType_Device))
\|\| x == '0'; elsif accdesc.acctype IN
{[AccessType_IC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IC),
[AccessType_DC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_DC)}
then return FALSE; elsif accdesc.write then return w == '0'; else return
r == '0'; end; end;

### Library pseudocode for aarch32/translation/faults/AArch32_S2InconsistentSL

<span id="aarch32.translation.faults.AArch32_S2InconsistentSL">//
AArch32_S2InconsistentSL() // ========================== // Detect
inconsistent configuration of stage 2 T0SZ and SL fields func</span>
<span id="func_AArch32_S2InconsistentSL_1">AArch32_S2InconsistentSL(walkparams
:</span>
[S2TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2TTWParams))
=\> boolean begin let startlevel : integer =
[AArch32_S2StartLevel](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_S2StartLevel_1)(walkparams.sl0);
let levels : integer =
[FINAL_LEVEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_FINAL_LEVEL) -
startlevel; let granulebits :
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize)
=
[TGxGranuleBits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_TGxGranuleBits_1)(walkparams.tgx);
let stride : integer{} = granulebits - 3; // Input address size must at
least be large enough to be resolved from the start level let
sl_min_iasize : integer = ( levels \* stride // Bits resolved by table
walk, except initial level + granulebits // Bits directly mapped to
output address + 1); // At least 1 more bit to be decoded by initial
level // Can accommodate 1 more stride in the level + concatenation of
up to 2^4 tables let sl_max_iasize : integer = sl_min_iasize +
(stride-1) + 4; // Configured Input Address size let iasize :
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize)
=
[AArch32_S2IASize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch32_S2IASize_1)(walkparams.t0sz);
return iasize \< sl_min_iasize \|\| iasize \> sl_max_iasize; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.debug.brbe.BranchEncCycleCount">//
BranchEncCycleCount() // ===================== // The first return
result is '1' if either of the following is true, and '0' otherwise:
// - This is the first Branch record after the PE exited a Prohibited
Region. // - This is the first Branch record after cycle counting has
been enabled. // If the first return is '0', the second return result is
the encoded cycle count // since the last branch. // The format of this
field uses a mantissa and exponent to express the cycle count value.
// - bits\[7:0\] indicate the mantissa M. // - bits\[13:8\] indicate the
exponent E. // The cycle count is expressed using the following
function: // cycle_count = (if IsZero(E) then UInt(M) else
UInt('1'::M::Zeros{UInt(E)-1})) // A value of all ones in both the
mantissa and exponent indicates the cycle count value // exceeded the
size of the cycle counter. // If the cycle count is not known, the
second return result is zero. func</span>
<span id="func_BranchEncCycleCount_0">BranchEncCycleCount() =\> (bit,
bits(14)) begin var cc : integer =</span>
[BranchRawCycleCount](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_BranchRawCycleCount_0)();
if
\![BRBCycleCountingEnabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_BRBCycleCountingEnabled_0)()
\|\|
[FirstBranchAfterProhibited](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FirstBranchAfterProhibited_0)()
then return ('1', Zeros{14}); end; // The format of this field uses a
mantissa and exponent to express the cycle count value. // - bits\[7:0\]
indicate the mantissa M. // - bits\[13:8\] indicate the exponent E. //
The cycle count is expressed using the following function: //
cycle_count = (if IsZero(E) then UInt(M) else
UInt('1'::M::Zeros{UInt(E)-1})) // A value of all ones in both the
mantissa and exponent indicates the cycle count value // exceeded the
size of the cycle counter. var E : bits(6); var M : bits(8); if cc \<
2^8 then E = Zeros{6}; M = cc\[7:0\]; elsif cc \>= 2^20 then E =
Ones{6}; M = Ones{8}; else E = 1\[5:0\]; while cc \>= 2^9 looplimit 11
do E = E + 1; cc = cc DIVRM 2; end; M = cc\[7:0\]; end; return ('0',
E::M); end;

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPECycle">// SPECycle() //
========== // Function called at the end of every cycle. Responsible for
asserting interrupts // and advancing counters. func</span>
<span id="func_SPECycle_0">SPECycle() begin if
!IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE) then return; end; // Increment pending
counters if</span>
[SPESampleInFlight](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleInFlight)
then for i = 0 to
([SPEMaxCounters](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPEMaxCounters) - 1)
do if
[SPESampleCounterPending](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleCounterPending)\[\[i\]\]
then
[SPESampleCounter](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleCounter)\[\[i\]\]
=
[SPESampleCounter](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleCounter)\[\[i\]\] +
1; end; end; end; // Assert PMBIRQ if appropriate. if
[SPEInterruptEnabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SPEInterruptEnabled_0)()
&& PMBSR_EL1().S == '1' then
SetInterruptRequestLevel([InterruptID_PMBIRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_InterruptID_PMBIRQ),
[HIGH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_HIGH));
else
SetInterruptRequestLevel([InterruptID_PMBIRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_InterruptID_PMBIRQ),
[LOW](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_LOW));
end; end;

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEEncodeETS"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/debug/statisticalprofiling/SPEEncodeETS

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEEncodeETS">//
SPEEncodeETS() // ============== // Encodes an integer tile size length
into the ets field for the SPE operation type packet. func</span>
<span id="func_SPEEncodeETS_1">SPEEncodeETS(size : integer) =\> bits(4)
begin var ets : bits(4); if size \<= 128 then ets = '0000'; elsif size
\<= 256 then ets = '0001'; elsif size \<= 512 then ets = '0010'; elsif
size \<= 1024 then ets = '0011'; elsif size \<= 2048 then ets = '0100';
elsif size \<= 4096 then ets = '0101'; elsif size \<= 8192 then ets =
'0110'; elsif size \<= 16384 then ets = '0111'; elsif size \<= 32768
then ets = '1000'; elsif size \<= 65536 then ets = '1001'; elsif size
\<= 131072 then ets = '1010'; elsif size \<= 262144 then ets = '1011';
else ets = '1111'; end; return ets; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="func_SPEEncodeETS_1"></span><span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEEncodeEVL"></span>

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEEncodeEVL">//
SPEEncodeEVL() // ============== // Encodes an integer vector length
into the evl field for the SPE operation type packet. func</span>
<span id="func_SPEEncodeEVL_1">SPEEncodeEVL(vl : integer) =\> bits(3)
begin var evl : bits(3); if vl \<= 32 then evl = '000'; elsif vl \<= 64
then evl = '001'; elsif vl \<= 128 then evl = '010'; elsif vl \<= 256
then evl = '011'; elsif vl \<= 512 then evl = '100'; elsif vl \<= 1024
then evl = '101'; elsif vl \<= 2048 then evl = '110'; else if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_SME) then evl = '111'; else unreachable;
end; end; return evl; end;</span>

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEFilterByEvents">//
SPEFilterByEvents() // =================== // Carries out filtering by
the event bits. func</span>
<span id="func_SPEFilterByEvents_1">SPEFilterByEvents(events : bits(64))
=\> (boolean, boolean) begin // "mask" defines which Events packet bits
are checked by the filter var mask : bits(64) = Zeros{}; let impdef_mask
: bits(64) = ImpDefBits{}("SPE mask"); mask\[63:48\] =
impdef_mask\[63:48\]; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_SME) &&
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p4) then mask\[25:24\] = '11'; //
Streaming mode, SMCU end; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p4) then
mask\[23:19\] = '11111'; // Snoop hit, recent fetch, modified, // L2
miss, L2 access else mask\[31:24\] = impdef_mask\[31:24\]; end; if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p1) && IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SVE)
then mask\[18:17\] = '11'; // Predicates end; mask\[15:12\] =
impdef_mask\[15:12\]; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p1) then
mask\[11\] = '1'; // Data alignment end; if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p4) then mask\[10:8\] = '111'; // Remote
access, LLC access, LLC miss else mask\[10:8\] = impdef_mask\[10:8\];
end; mask\[7\] = '1'; // Mispredicted if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_FnE) then mask\[6\] = '1'; // Not taken
end; mask\[5,3,1\] = '111'; // TLB walk, L1 miss, retired if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p4) then mask\[4,2\] = '11'; // TLB
access, L1 access else mask\[4,2\] = impdef_mask\[4,2\]; end; let e :
bits(64) = events AND mask; // Filtering by event let evfr : bits(64) =
PMSEVFR_EL1() AND mask; var is_rejected_event : boolean = FALSE; let
is_evt : boolean = IsZero(NOT(e) AND evfr); if PMSFCR_EL1().FE == '1'
then // Filtering by event is enabled if !IsZero(evfr) then // Not a
CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE case is_rejected_event = !is_evt; else
is_rejected_event =</span>
[ConstrainUnpredictableBool](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableBool_1)([Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR));
end; end; // Filtering by inverse event var is_rejected_nevent : boolean
= FALSE; var is_nevt : boolean; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_FnE)
then let nevfr : bits(64) = PMSNEVFR_EL1() AND mask; is_nevt = IsZero(e
AND nevfr); if PMSFCR_EL1().FnE == '1' then // Inverse filtering by
event is enabled if !IsZero(nevfr) then // Not a CONSTRAINED
UNPREDICTABLE case is_rejected_nevent = !is_nevt; else
is_rejected_nevent =
[ConstrainUnpredictableBool](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableBool_1)([Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR));
end; end; else is_nevt = TRUE; // not implemented end; if is_evt &&
is_nevt then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_EVENT);
end; if (IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_FnE) && PMSFCR_EL1().\[FnE,FE\]==
'11' && !IsZero(PMSEVFR_EL1() AND PMSNEVFR_EL1() AND mask)) then //
CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE case due to combination of filter and inverse
filter is_rejected_nevent =
[ConstrainUnpredictableBool](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableBool_1)([Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR));
is_rejected_event =
[ConstrainUnpredictableBool](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableBool_1)([Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR));
end; return (is_rejected_event, is_rejected_nevent); end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEFilterByType">//
SPEFilterByType() // ================= // Returns TRUE if the operation
is to be discarded because of its OpAttrs, and FALSE otherwise.
func</span> <span id="func_SPEFilterByType_1">SPEFilterByType(opattr
:</span>
[SPEOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SPEOpAttr))
=\> boolean begin // Bit positions in the PMSFCR_EL1().\[TYPE, TYPEm\]
fields let B : integer = 0; let LD : integer = 1; let ST : integer = 2;
let FP : integer = 3; let SIMD : integer = 4; var flags : bits(5) =
Zeros{}; var ctrl : bits(5) = Zeros{}; // With GCS, Branch Link and
Procedure Return instructions write and read the GCS. // BL and RET
instructions with GCS enabled call SPESampleLoadStore() before //
branch/packet construction, setting ldst_type to indicate a GCS access.
let is_gcs_ldst : boolean = (opattr.op_type ==
[SPEOpType_Branch](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Branch)
&& opattr.ldst_type ==
[SPELDSTType_GCS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPELDSTType_GCS));
let is_load : boolean = (opattr.op_type IN
{[SPEOpType_Load](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Load),
[SPEOpType_LoadAtomic](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_LoadAtomic)}
\|\| (is_gcs_ldst && opattr.procedure_return)); let is_store : boolean =
(opattr.op_type IN
{[SPEOpType_Store](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Store),
[SPEOpType_LoadAtomic](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_LoadAtomic)}
\|\| (is_gcs_ldst && opattr.branch_has_link)); flags\[B\] = (if
opattr.op_type ==
[SPEOpType_Branch](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Branch)
then '1' else '0'); flags\[LD\] = (if is_load then '1' else '0');
flags\[ST\] = (if is_store then '1' else '0'); flags\[FP\] = (if
opattr.is_floating_point then '1' else '0'); flags\[SIMD\] = (if
opattr.is_simd then '1' else '0'); ctrl\[2:0\] =
PMSFCR_EL1().TYPE\[2:0\]; var mask : bits(5) = Zeros{}; if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_EFT) then ctrl\[4:3\] =
PMSFCR_EL1().TYPE\[4:3\]; mask\[4:0\] = PMSFCR_EL1().TYPEm; end; let
ctrl_or : bits(5) = (ctrl AND (NOT mask)); let ctrl_and : bits(5) =
(ctrl AND mask); let is_op : boolean = ((IsZero(ctrl_or) \|\|
!IsZero(flags AND ctrl_or)) && ((flags AND mask) == ctrl_and)); if
flags\[B\] == '1' then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_BR);
end; if flags\[LD\] == '1' then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_LD);
end; if flags\[ST\] == '1' then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_ST);
end; if flags\[FP\] == '1' then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_FP);
end; if flags\[SIMD\] == '1' then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_SIMD);
end; var is_rejected_type : boolean = FALSE; if PMSFCR_EL1().FT == '1'
then // Filtering by type is enabled if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_EFT) \|\| !IsZero(ctrl) then
is_rejected_type = !is_op; else is_rejected_type =
[ConstrainUnpredictableBool](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableBool_1)([Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_BADPMSFCR));
end; end; if is_op && (!IsZero(ctrl) \|\| !IsZero(mask)) then
[PMUEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUEvent_1)(PMU_EVENT_SAMPLE_FEED_OP);
end; return is_rejected_type; end;

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEFreezeOnEvent">//
SPEFreezeOnEvent() // ================== // Returns TRUE if PMU event
counter idx should be frozen due to an SPE event, and FALSE otherwise.
func</span> <span id="func_SPEFreezeOnEvent_1">SPEFreezeOnEvent(idx :
integer) =\> boolean begin let counters : integer = NUM_PMU_COUNTERS;
assert (idx \>= 0 && (idx \< counters \|\| idx ==</span>
[CYCLE_COUNTER_ID](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_CYCLE_COUNTER_ID)
\|\| (idx ==
[INSTRUCTION_COUNTER_ID](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_INSTRUCTION_COUNTER_ID)
&& IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PMUv3_ICNTR)))); if
!IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPEv1p2) \|\|
!IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PMUv3p7) then return FALSE; end; if idx ==
[CYCLE_COUNTER_ID](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_CYCLE_COUNTER_ID)
&& !IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_DPFZS) then // FZS does not affect the

let freeze_on_event : boolean = PMBLIMITR_EL1().\[E,PMFZ\] == '11'; let
stopped : boolean =
[SPEProfilingStopped](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SPEProfilingStopped_0)();
case
[GetPMUCounterRange](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_GetPMUCounterRange_1)(idx)
of when
[PMUCounterRange_R1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PMUCounterRange_R1)
=\> return freeze_on_event && stopped && PMCR_EL0().FZS == '1'; when
[PMUCounterRange_R2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PMUCounterRange_R2)
=\> return freeze_on_event && stopped && MDCR_EL2().HPMFZS == '1';
otherwise =\> return FALSE; end; end;

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/debug/statisticalprofiling/SPEMultiAccessSample

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPEMultiAccessSample">//
SPEMultiAccessSample() // ====================== // Called by
instructions which make at least one store and one load access, where
the configuration // of the operation type filter affects which access
is sampled. func</span>
<span id="func_SPEMultiAccessSample_0">SPEMultiAccessSample() =\>
boolean begin // If loads or stores are filtered out, the other should
be recorded. // If neither or both are filtered out, pick one in an
unbiased way. // Bit positions in the PMSFCR_EL1().\[TYPE, TYPEm\]
fields. let LD : integer = 1; let ST : integer = 2; // Are loads allowed
by filter? let loads_pass_filter : boolean = PMSFCR_EL1().FT == '1' &&
PMSFCR_EL1().TYPE\[LD\] == '1'; // Are stores allowed by filter? let
stores_pass_filter : boolean = PMSFCR_EL1().FT == '1' &&
PMSFCR_EL1().TYPE\[ST\] == '1'; var record_load : boolean; if
loads_pass_filter && !stores_pass_filter then // Only loads pass filter
record_load = TRUE; elsif !loads_pass_filter && stores_pass_filter then
// Only stores pass filter record_load = FALSE; else // Both loads and
stores pass the filter or neither pass the filter. // Pick between the
load or the store access (pseudo-)randomly. record_load =</span>
[SPEGetRandomBoolean](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SPEGetRandomBoolean_0)();
end; return record_load; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPESampleLoadStore"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/debug/statisticalprofiling/SPESampleLoadStore

<span id="aarch64.debug.statisticalprofiling.SPESampleLoadStore">//
SPESampleLoadStore() // ==================== // Called if a sample is in
flight when writing or reading memory, // indicating that the operation
being sampled is in the Load, Store or atomic category. func</span>
<span id="func_SPESampleLoadStore_3">SPESampleLoadStore(is_load :
boolean, accdesc :</span>
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor),
addrdesc :
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor))
begin // Check if this access type is suitable to be sampled. // This
implementation of SPE always samples the first access made by a suitable
instruction. // FEAT_MOPS instructions are an exception, where the first
load or first store access may be // selected based on the configuration
of the sample filters. if accdesc.acctype IN
{[AccessType_SPE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_SPE),
[AccessType_IFETCH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IFETCH),
[AccessType_TRBE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_TRBE),
[AccessType_DC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_DC),
[AccessType_TTW](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_TTW),
[AccessType_AT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_AT)}
then return; end; var sample_access : boolean = FALSE; // For FEAT_MOPS
and FEAT_GCS GCSSS2 instructions which perform both loads and stores,
the // filter configuration will influence which part of the access is
chosen to be sampled. if
([SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).ldst_type
IN
{[SPELDSTType_MemCopy](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPELDSTType_MemCopy),
[SPELDSTType_MemSet](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPELDSTType_MemSet),
[SPELDSTType_GCSSS2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPELDSTType_GCSSS2)})
then // SPEMultiAccessSample() will have been called before this
function, // and chooses whether to sample a load or a store. var
sample_load : boolean; sample_load =
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).op_type
IN
{[SPEOpType_Load](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Load),
[SPEOpType_LoadAtomic](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_LoadAtomic)};
// If no valid data has been collected, and this operation is acceptable
for sampling. if
\![SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).addr_valid
&& (is_load == sample_load) then sample_access = TRUE; end; else if
\![SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).addr_valid
then sample_access = TRUE; end; end; if sample_access then // Data
access virtual address
[SPESetDataVirtualAddress](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SPESetDataVirtualAddress_1)(addrdesc.vaddress);
// Data access physical address if
[CollectPhysicalAddress](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CollectPhysicalAddress_0)()
then
[SPESetDataPhysicalAddress](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SPESetDataPhysicalAddress_2)(addrdesc,
accdesc); end;
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).addr_valid
= TRUE; end; if
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).op_type
==
[SPEOpType_Invalid](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Invalid)
then // Set as unspecified load/store by default, instructions will
overwrite this if it does not // apply to them.
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).op_type
= if is_load then
[SPEOpType_Load](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Load)
else
[SPEOpType_Store](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Store);
if accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_NV2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_NV2)
then // NV2 register load/store
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).ldst_type
=
[SPELDSTType_NV2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPELDSTType_NV2);
end; end; // Set SPELDSTType to GCS for all GCS instruction, overwriting
type GCSSS2. // After selection of which operation of a GCSSS2
instruction to sample, GCSSS2 is treated the // same as other GCS
instructions. if accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_GCS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_GCS)
then
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).ldst_type
=
[SPELDSTType_GCS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPELDSTType_GCS);
// If the GCS access is from a BL or RET, this will get overwritten to
SPEOpType_Branch.
[SPESampleOpAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleOpAttr).op_type
= if is_load then
[SPEOpType_Load](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Load)
else
[SPEOpType_Store](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SPEOpType_Store);
end;
([SPESampleDataSourceValid](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleDataSourceValid),
[SPESampleDataSource](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleDataSource))
=
[SPEGetDataSource](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SPEGetDataSource_3)(is_load,
accdesc, addrdesc); end;

// Enter the highest implemented Exception level in AArch64 state

= '0'; if
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL
=
[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3);
elsif
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2))
then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL
=
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2);
else
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EL
=
[EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1);
end; // Reset System registers and other system components
AArch64_ResetControlRegisters(cold_reset); // Reset all other PSTATE
fields
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).SP
= '1'; // Select stack pointer PSTATE.\[D,A,I,F\] = '1111'; // All
asynchronous exceptions masked
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).SS
= '0'; // Clear software step bit
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).DIT
= '0'; // PSTATE.DIT is reset to 0 when resetting into AArch64 if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAuth_LR) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PACM
= '0'; // PAC modifier end; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SME) then

IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_GCS) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).EXLOCK
= '0'; // PSTATE.EXLOCK is reset to 0 when resetting into AArch64 end;
if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_UINJ) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).UINJ
= '0'; // PSTATE.UINJ is reset to 0 when resetting into AArch64 end;
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).IL

<span id="aarch64.functions.bfxpreferred.BFXPreferred">// BFXPreferred()
// ============== // // Return TRUE if UBFX or SBFX is the preferred
disassembly of a // UBFM or SBFM bitfield instruction. Must exclude more
specific // aliases UBFIZ, SBFIZ, UXT\[BH\], SXT\[BHW\], LSL, LSR and
ASR. func</span> <span id="func_BFXPreferred_4">BFXPreferred(sf : bit,
uns : bit, imms : bits(6), immr : bits(6)) =\> boolean begin // must not
match UBFIZ/SBFIX alias if UInt(imms) \< UInt(immr) then return FALSE;
end; // must not match LSR/ASR/LSL alias (imms == 31 or 63) if imms ==
sf::'11111' then return FALSE; end; // must not match UXTx/SXTx alias if
immr == '000000' then // must not match 32-bit UXT\[BH\] or SXT\[BH\] if
sf == '0' && imms IN {'000111', '001111'} then return FALSE; end; //
must not match 64-bit SXT\[BHW\] if sf::uns == '10' && imms IN
{'000111', '001111', '011111'} then return FALSE; end; end; // must be
UBFX/SBFX alias return TRUE; end;</span>
