<span id="aarch64.functions.bitmasks.AltDecodeBitMasks">//
AltDecodeBitMasks() // =================== // Alternative but logically
equivalent implementation of DecodeBitMasks() that // uses simpler
primitives to compute tmask and wmask. func</span>
<span id="func_AltDecodeBitMasks_5">AltDecodeBitMasks{M}(immN : bit,
imms : bits(6), immr : bits(6), immediate : boolean) =\> (bits(M),
bits(M)) begin var tmask, wmask : bits(64); var tmask_and, wmask_and :
bits(6); var tmask_or, wmask_or : bits(6); var levels : bits(6); //
Compute log2 of element size // 2^len must be in range \[2, M\] if
immN::NOT(imms) == '000000x' then Undefined(); end; let len : integer{}
= HighestSetBitNZ(immN::NOT(imms)); assert 2 \<= (2^len) && (2^len) \<=
M; // Determine s, r and s - r parameters levels =
ZeroExtend{6}(Ones{len}); // For logical immediates an all-ones value of
s is reserved // since it would generate a useless all-ones result (many
times) if immediate && (imms AND levels) == levels then Undefined();
end; let s : integer{} = UInt(imms AND levels); let r : integer{} =
UInt(immr AND levels); let diff : integer{} = s - r; // 6-bit subtract
with borrow // Compute "top mask" tmask_and = diff\[5:0\] OR
NOT(levels); tmask_or = diff\[5:0\] AND levels; tmask = Ones{64}; tmask
= ((tmask AND Replicate{64, 2}(Replicate{1}(tmask_and\[0\]) :: Ones{1}))
OR Replicate{64, 2}(Zeros{1} :: Replicate{1}(tmask_or\[0\]))); //
optimization of first step: // tmask = Replicate{64}(tmask_and\[0\] ::
'1'); tmask = ((tmask AND Replicate{64, 4}(Replicate{2}(tmask_and\[1\])
:: Ones{2})) OR Replicate{64, 4}(Zeros{2} ::
Replicate{2}(tmask_or\[1\]))); tmask = ((tmask AND Replicate{64,
8}(Replicate{4}(tmask_and\[2\]) :: Ones{4})) OR Replicate{64,
8}(Zeros{4} :: Replicate{4}(tmask_or\[2\]))); tmask = ((tmask AND
Replicate{64, 16}(Replicate{8}(tmask_and\[3\]) :: Ones{8})) OR
Replicate{64, 16}(Zeros{8} :: Replicate{8}(tmask_or\[3\]))); tmask =
((tmask AND Replicate{64, 32}(Replicate{16}(tmask_and\[4\]) ::
Ones{16})) OR Replicate{64, 32}(Zeros{16} ::
Replicate{16}(tmask_or\[4\]))); tmask = ((tmask AND Replicate{64,
64}(Replicate{32}(tmask_and\[5\]) :: Ones{32})) OR Replicate{64,
64}(Zeros{32} :: Replicate{32}(tmask_or\[5\]))); // Compute "wraparound
mask" wmask_and = immr OR NOT(levels); wmask_or = immr AND levels; wmask
= Zeros{64}; wmask = ((wmask AND Replicate{64, 2}(Ones{1} ::
Replicate{1}(wmask_and\[0\]))) OR Replicate{64,
2}(Replicate{1}(wmask_or\[0\]) :: Zeros{1})); // wmask =
Replicate{64}(wmask_or\[0\] :: '0'); wmask = ((wmask AND Replicate{64,
4}(Ones{2} :: Replicate{2}(wmask_and\[1\]))) OR Replicate{64,
4}(Replicate{2}(wmask_or\[1\]) :: Zeros{2})); wmask = ((wmask AND
Replicate{64, 8}(Ones{4} :: Replicate{4}(wmask_and\[2\]))) OR
Replicate{64, 8}(Replicate{4}(wmask_or\[2\]) :: Zeros{4})); wmask =
((wmask AND Replicate{64, 16}(Ones{8} :: Replicate{8}(wmask_and\[3\])))
OR Replicate{64, 16}(Replicate{8}(wmask_or\[3\]) :: Zeros{8})); wmask =
((wmask AND Replicate{64, 32}(Ones{16} ::
Replicate{16}(wmask_and\[4\]))) OR Replicate{64,
32}(Replicate{16}(wmask_or\[4\]) :: Zeros{16})); wmask = ((wmask AND
Replicate{64, 64}(Ones{32} :: Replicate{32}(wmask_and\[5\]))) OR
Replicate{64, 64}(Replicate{32}(wmask_or\[5\]) :: Zeros{32})); if
diff\[6\] != '0' then // borrow from s - r wmask = wmask AND tmask; else
wmask = wmask OR tmask; end; return (wmask\[M-1:0\], tmask\[M-1:0\]);

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/bitmasks/DecodeBitMasks

<span id="aarch64.functions.bitmasks.DecodeBitMasks">// DecodeBitMasks()
// ================ // Decode AArch64 bitfield and logical immediate
masks which use a similar encoding structure func</span>
<span id="func_DecodeBitMasks_5">DecodeBitMasks{M}(immN : bit, imms :
bits(6), immr : bits(6), immediate : boolean) =\> (bits(M), bits(M))
begin var levels : bits(6); // Compute log2 of element size // 2^len
must be in range \[2, M\] if immN::NOT(imms) == '000000x' then
Undefined(); end; let len : integer{} =
HighestSetBitNZ(immN::NOT(imms)); assert 2 \<= (2^len) && (2^len) \<= M;
// Determine s, r and s - r parameters levels =
ZeroExtend{6}(Ones{len}); // For logical immediates an all-ones value of
s is reserved // since it would generate a useless all-ones result (many
times) if immediate && (imms AND levels) == levels then Undefined();
end; let s : integer{} = UInt(imms AND levels); let r : integer{} =
UInt(immr AND levels); let diff : integer{} = s - r; // 6-bit subtract
with borrow let esize : integer{} = 1 \<\< len; let d : integer{} =
UInt(diff\[len-1:0\]); let welem : bits(esize) = ZeroExtend{}(Ones{s +
1}); let telem : bits(esize) = ZeroExtend{}(Ones{d + 1}); let wmask :
bits(M) = Replicate{}(ROR(welem, r)); let tmask : bits(M) =
Replicate{}(telem); return (wmask, tmask); end;</span>

</div>

<span id="aarch64.functions.dc.AArch64_TreatDCAsNOP"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/dc/AArch64_TreatDCAsNOP

<span id="aarch64.functions.dc.AArch64_TreatDCAsNOP">//
AArch64_TreatDCAsNOP() // ====================== // Determines whether
the execution of the DC instruction is treated as a NOP. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_TreatDCAsNOP_3">AArch64_TreatDCAsNOP(cachetype
:</span>
[CacheType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_CacheType),
cacheop :
[CacheOp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_CacheOp),
opscope :
[CacheOpScope](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_CacheOpScope))
=\> boolean begin // DC to PoU: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED - treated as NOP
if LoUU and LoUIS are 0 if opscope ==
[CacheOpScope_PoU](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CacheOpScope_PoU)
&& CLIDR_EL1().LoUU == '000' && CLIDR_EL1().LoUIS == '000' then return
ImpDefBool("DC to PoU is treated as a NOP"); end; // DC to PoC:
IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED - treated as NOP if LoC is 0 if opscope ==
[CacheOpScope_PoC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CacheOpScope_PoC)
&& CLIDR_EL1().LoC == '000' then return ImpDefBool("DC to PoC is treated
as a NOP"); end; // DC to PoP: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED - treated as NOP
if LoC is 0 and PoP unsupported if (opscope ==
[CacheOpScope_PoP](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CacheOpScope_PoP)
&& CLIDR_EL1().LoC == '000' && !ImpDefBool("Memory system supports
PoP")) then return ImpDefBool("DC to PoP is treated as a NOP"); end; //
DC to PoDP: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED - treated as NOP if LoC is 0 and
PoP/PoDP unsupported if (opscope ==
[CacheOpScope_PoDP](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CacheOpScope_PoDP)
&& CLIDR_EL1().LoC == '000' && !ImpDefBool("Memory system supports PoP")
&& !ImpDefBool("Memory system supports PoDP")) then return
ImpDefBool("DC to PoDP is treated as a NOP"); end; return FALSE; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.functions.fpscale.FPClampScale">// FPClampScale() //
============== func</span>
<span id="func_FPClampScale_3">FPClampScale{N}(op : bits(N), scale_in :
integer) =\> integer begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; var E : integer; var
exp : integer; case N of when 16 =\> E = 5; exp = UInt(op\[14:10\]);
when 32 =\> E = 8; exp = UInt(op\[30:23\]); when 64 =\> E = 11; exp =
UInt(op\[62:52\]); otherwise =\> unreachable; end; let F : integer = N -
(E + 1); let emax : integer = (1 \<\< E) - 1; let min_scale : integer =
-(F + 1); let max_scale : integer = emax + (F + 1); let scale : integer
= Max(min_scale - exp, Min(scale_in, max_scale - exp)); return scale;
end;</span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/memory/MemSingleGranule

<span id="aarch64.functions.memory.MemSingleGranule">//
MemSingleGranule() // ================== // When FEAT_LSE2 is
implemented, for some memory accesses if all bytes // of the accesses
are within 16-byte quantity aligned to 16-bytes and // satisfy
additional requirements - then the access is guaranteed to // be single
copy atomic. // However, when the accesses do not all lie within such a
boundary, it // is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE if the access is single
copy atomic. // In the pseudocode, this CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE aspect
is modeled via // MemSingleGranule() which is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED
and, is at least 16 bytes // and at most 4096 bytes. // This is a
limitation of the pseudocode. func</span>
<span id="func_MemSingleGranule_0">MemSingleGranule() =\> integer begin
let size : integer = ImpDefInt("Aligned quantity for atomic access"); //
access is assumed to be within 4096 byte aligned quantity to // avoid
multiple translations for a single copy atomic access. assert (size \>=
16) && (size \<= 4096); return size; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="aarch64.functions.mops.IsMemCpyForward"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/mops/IsMemCpyForward

<span id="aarch64.functions.mops.IsMemCpyForward">// IsMemCpyForward()
// ================= // Returns TRUE if in a memcpy of size cpysize
bytes from the source address fromaddress // to destination address
toaddress is done in the forward direction on this implementation.
func</span> <span id="func_IsMemCpyForward_1">IsMemCpyForward(memcpy
:</span>
[CPYParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_CPYParams))
=\> boolean begin var forward : boolean; // Check for overlapping cases
if ((UInt(memcpy.fromaddress\[55:0\]) \> UInt(memcpy.toaddress\[55:0\]))
&& (UInt(memcpy.fromaddress\[55:0\]) \<
UInt(ZeroExtend{64}(memcpy.toaddress\[55:0\]) + memcpy.cpysize))) then
forward = TRUE; elsif ((UInt(memcpy.fromaddress\[55:0\]) \<
UInt(memcpy.toaddress\[55:0\])) &&
(UInt(ZeroExtend{64}(memcpy.fromaddress\[55:0\]) + memcpy.cpysize) \>
UInt(memcpy.toaddress\[55:0\]))) then forward = FALSE; //
Non-overlapping case else forward = ImpDefBool("CPY in the forward
direction"); end; return forward; end;

</div>

\![IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(memaddrdesc)

DIV
[TAG_GRANULE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_TAG_GRANULE)

[AArch64_MemTagWrite](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_MemTagWrite_3)(tagaddr,
accdesc, tag); tagstep = tagstep - 1; end; if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(memaddrdesc)
\|\|
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(memstatus)
then tagstep = tagstep + 1; end; let tags_written : integer = (size DIV
[TAG_GRANULE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_TAG_GRANULE)) -

= memcpy.toaddress + copied;
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.s)
= memcpy.fromaddress + copied; else
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.n)
= (memcpy.cpysize - copied)\[63:0\]; end; end; else if
memcpy.implements_option_a then if memcpy.forward then
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.n)
= (memcpy.cpysize + copied)\[63:0\]; else
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.n)
= (memcpy.cpysize - copied)\[63:0\]; end; else

= memcpy.toaddress + copied;
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.s)
= memcpy.fromaddress + copied; else
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.d)
= memcpy.toaddress - copied;
[X](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#accessor_X_2){64}(memcpy.s)
= memcpy.fromaddress - copied; end; end; end; else

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/movwpreferred/MoveWidePreferred

<span id="aarch64.functions.movwpreferred.MoveWidePreferred">//
MoveWidePreferred() // =================== // // Return TRUE if a
bitmask immediate encoding would generate an immediate // value that
could also be represented by a single MOVZ or MOVN instruction. // Used
as a condition for the preferred MOV\<-ORR alias. func</span>
<span id="func_MoveWidePreferred_4">MoveWidePreferred(sf : bit, immN :
bit, imms : bits(6), immr : bits(6)) =\> boolean begin let s : integer =
UInt(imms); let r : integer = UInt(immr); let width : integer = if sf ==
'1' then 64 else 32; // element size must equal total immediate size if
sf == '1' && (immN::imms) != '1xxxxxx' then return FALSE; end; if sf ==
'0' && (immN::imms) != '00xxxxx' then return FALSE; end; // for MOVZ
must contain no more than 16 ones if s \< 16 then // ones must not span
halfword boundary when rotated return (-r MOD 16) \<= (15 - s); end; //
for MOVN must contain no more than 16 zeros if s \>= width - 15 then //
zeros must not span halfword boundary when rotated return (r MOD 16) \<=
(s - (width - 15)); end; return FALSE; end;</span>

</div>

modifier, Zeros{64}, use_modifier2, K, data, key_number, is_combined);

<span id="func_ComputePACQARMA_5">ComputePACQARMA(data : bits(64),
modifier : bits(64), key0 : bits(64), key1 : bits(64), isqarma3 :
boolean) =\> bits(64) begin var workingval : bits(64); var runningmod :
bits(64); var roundkey : bits(64); var modk0 : bits(64); let Alpha :
bits(64) = 0xC0AC29B7C97C50DD\[63:0\]; var iterations : integer;</span>
[RC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_RC)\[\[0\]\]
= 0x0000000000000000\[63:0\];
[RC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_RC)\[\[1\]\]
= 0x13198A2E03707344\[63:0\];
[RC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_RC)\[\[2\]\]
= 0xA4093822299F31D0\[63:0\]; if isqarma3 then iterations = 2; else //
QARMA5 iterations = 4;
[RC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_RC)\[\[3\]\]
= 0x082EFA98EC4E6C89\[63:0\];
[RC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_RC)\[\[4\]\]
= 0x452821E638D01377\[63:0\]; end; modk0 =
key0\[0\]::key0\[63:2\]::(key0\[63\] XOR key0\[1\]); runningmod =
modifier; workingval = data XOR key0; for i = 0 to iterations do
roundkey = key1 XOR runningmod; workingval = workingval XOR roundkey;
workingval = workingval XOR
[RC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_RC)\[\[i\]\];
if i \> 0 then workingval =
[PACCellShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACCellShuffle_1)(workingval);

[PACMult](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACMult_1)(workingval);
end; if isqarma3 then workingval =
[PACSub1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACSub1_1)(workingval);
else workingval =
[PACSub](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACSub_1)(workingval);

[TweakShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_TweakShuffle_1)(runningmod\[63:0\]);
end; roundkey = modk0 XOR runningmod; workingval = workingval XOR
roundkey; workingval =
[PACCellShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACCellShuffle_1)(workingval);
workingval =
[PACMult](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACMult_1)(workingval);
if isqarma3 then workingval =
[PACSub1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACSub1_1)(workingval);
else workingval =
[PACSub](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACSub_1)(workingval);
end; workingval =
[PACCellShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACCellShuffle_1)(workingval);
workingval =
[PACMult](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACMult_1)(workingval);
workingval = key1 XOR workingval; workingval =
[PACCellInvShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACCellInvShuffle_1)(workingval);
if isqarma3 then workingval =
[PACSub1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACSub1_1)(workingval);
else workingval =
[PACInvSub](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACInvSub_1)(workingval);
end; workingval =
[PACMult](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACMult_1)(workingval);
workingval =
[PACCellInvShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACCellInvShuffle_1)(workingval);
workingval = workingval XOR key0; workingval = workingval XOR

[PACMult](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACMult_1)(workingval);

[PACCellInvShuffle](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PACCellInvShuffle_1)(workingval);

[ShiftType_ROR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_ShiftType_ROR)

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/sme/CounterToPredicate

<span id="aarch64.functions.sme.CounterToPredicate">//
CounterToPredicate() // ==================== func</span>
<span id="func_CounterToPredicate_2">CounterToPredicate{width}(pred :
bits(16)) =\> bits(width) begin var count : integer; var esize :</span>
[ESize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_ESize);
var elements : integer; let VL :
[VecLen](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_VecLen)
=
[CurrentVL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CurrentVL_0)();
let PL :
[PredLen](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PredLen)
= VL DIV 8; let maxbit : integer{} = FloorLog2(PL \* 4) as
integer{0..14}; var result : bits(PL\*4); let invert : boolean =
pred\[15\] == '1'; assert width == PL \|\| width == PL\*2 \|\| width ==
PL\*3 \|\| width == PL\*4; case pred\[3:0\] of when '0000' =\> return
Zeros{width}; when 'xxx1' =\> count = UInt(pred\[maxbit:1\]); esize = 8;
when 'xx10' =\> count = UInt(pred\[maxbit:2\]); esize = 16; when 'x100'
=\> count = UInt(pred\[maxbit:3\]); esize = 32; when '1000' =\> count =
UInt(pred\[maxbit:4\]); esize = 64; end; elements = (VL \* 4) DIV esize;
result = Zeros{PL\*4}; let psize : integer{} = esize DIV 8; for e = 0 to
elements-1 do var pbit : bit = if e \< count then '1' else '0'; if
invert then pbit = NOT(pbit); end; result\[e\*:psize\] =
ZeroExtend{psize}(pbit); end; return result\[width-1:0\]; end;

</div>

<span id="func_EncodePredCount_5">EncodePredCount{width}(esize :</span>
[ESize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_ESize),
elements : integer, count_in : integer, invert_in : boolean) =\>
bits(width) begin var count : integer = count_in; var invert : boolean =
invert_in; let PL :
[PredLen](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PredLen)
=
[CurrentVL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CurrentVL_0)()
DIV 8; assert width == PL; assert count \>=0 && count \<= elements; var
pred : bits(16); if count == 0 then return Zeros{width}; end; if invert
then count = elements - count; elsif count == elements then count = 0;
invert = TRUE; end; let inv : bit = (if invert then '1' else '0'); case
esize of when 8 =\> pred = inv :: count\[13:0\] :: '1'; when 16 =\> pred
= inv :: count\[12:0\] :: '10'; when 32 =\> pred = inv :: count\[11:0\]
:: '100'; when 64 =\> pred = inv :: count\[10:0\] :: '1000'; end; return
ZeroExtend{width}(pred); end;

<span id="func_PredCountTest_3">PredCountTest(elements : integer, count

end;</span>

<span id="func_BitExtract_3"></span><span id="aarch64.functions.sve.BitGroup"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/sve/BitGroup

<span id="aarch64.functions.sve.BitGroup">// BitGroup() // ========== //
Extract and pack DATA bits selected by the nonzero bits in MASK into //
the least significant result bits, and pack unselected bits into the //
most significant result bits. func</span>
<span id="func_BitGroup_3">BitGroup{N}(data : bits(N), mask : bits(N))
=\> bits(N) begin var res : bits(N); var rb : integer = 0; // compress
masked bits to right for db = 0 to N-1 do if mask\[db\] == '1' then
res\[rb\] = data\[db\]; rb = rb + 1; end; end; // compress unmasked bits
to left for db = 0 to N-1 do if mask\[db\] == '0' then res\[rb\] =
data\[db\]; rb = rb + 1; end; end; return res; end;</span>

</div>

: integer) =\></span>
[VecLen](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_VecLen)
begin let maxbits :

=

: integer = Min(nbits_in, maxbits); assert 128 \<= nbits && nbits \<=
2048 && AlignDownSize(nbits, 128) == nbits; // Search for a supported
power-of-two VL less than or equal to nbits while nbits \> 128 &&
!SupportedPowerTwoSVL(nbits) looplimit 7 do nbits = nbits - 128; end; //
Return the smallest supported power-of-two VL while nbits \< maxbits &&
!SupportedPowerTwoSVL(nbits) looplimit 7 do nbits = nbits \* 2; end;
return nbits as
[VecLen](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_VecLen);

<span id="aarch64.functions.sve.SVEMoveMaskPreferred">//
SVEMoveMaskPreferred() // ====================== // Return FALSE if a
bitmask immediate encoding would generate an immediate // value that
could also be represented by a single DUP instruction. // Used as a
condition for the preferred MOV\<-DUPM alias. func</span>
<span id="func_SVEMoveMaskPreferred_1">SVEMoveMaskPreferred(imm13 :
bits(13)) =\> boolean begin var imm : bits(64); (imm, -) =</span>
[DecodeBitMasks](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_DecodeBitMasks_5){64}(imm13\[12\],
imm13\[5:0\], imm13\[11:6\], TRUE); // Check for 8 bit immediates if
!IsZero(imm\[7:0\]) then // Check for 'ffffffffffffffxy' or
'00000000000000xy' if IsZero(imm\[63:7\]) \|\| IsOnes(imm\[63:7\]) then
return FALSE; end; // Check for 'ffffffxyffffffxy' or '000000xy000000xy'
if imm\[63:32\] == imm\[31:0\] && (IsZero(imm\[31:7\]) \|\|
IsOnes(imm\[31:7\])) then return FALSE; end; // Check for
'ffxyffxyffxyffxy' or '00xy00xy00xy00xy' if (imm\[63:32\] == imm\[31:0\]
&& imm\[31:16\] == imm\[15:0\] && (IsZero(imm\[15:7\]) \|\|
IsOnes(imm\[15:7\]))) then return FALSE; end; // Check for
'xyxyxyxyxyxyxyxy' if imm\[63:32\] == imm\[31:0\] && imm\[31:16\] ==
imm\[15:0\] && (imm\[15:8\] == imm\[7:0\]) then return FALSE; end; //
Check for 16 bit immediates else // Check for 'ffffffffffffxy00' or
'000000000000xy00' if IsZero(imm\[63:15\]) \|\| IsOnes(imm\[63:15\])
then return FALSE; end; // Check for 'ffffxy00ffffxy00' or
'0000xy000000xy00' if imm\[63:32\] == imm\[31:0\] &&
(IsZero(imm\[31:7\]) \|\| IsOnes(imm\[31:7\])) then return FALSE; end;
// Check for 'xy00xy00xy00xy00' if imm\[63:32\] == imm\[31:0\] &&
imm\[31:16\] == imm\[15:0\] then return FALSE; end; end; return TRUE;
end;

<span id="aarch64.functions.system.AArch64_ChooseNonExcludedTag">//
AArch64_ChooseNonExcludedTag() // ============================== //
Return a tag derived from the start and the offset values, excluding //
any tags in the given mask. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_ChooseNonExcludedTag_3">AArch64_ChooseNonExcludedTag(tag_in
: bits(4), offset_in : bits(4), exclude : bits(16)) =\> bits(4) begin
var tag : bits(4) = tag_in; var offset : bits(4) = offset_in; if
IsOnes(exclude) then return '0000'; end; if offset == '0000' then while
exclude\[UInt(tag)\] == '1' looplimit 16 do tag = tag + '0001'; end;
end; while offset != '0000' looplimit 16 do offset = offset - '0001';
tag = tag + '0001'; while exclude\[UInt(tag)\] == '1' looplimit 16 do
tag = tag + '0001'; end; end; return tag; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="aarch64.functions.system.ChooseRandomNonExcludedTag">//
ChooseRandomNonExcludedTag() // ============================ // The
ChooseRandomNonExcludedTag function is used when GCR_EL1.RRND == '1' to
generate random // Allocation Tags. // // The resulting Allocation Tag
is selected from the set \[0,15\], excluding any Allocation Tag where //
exclude\[tag_value\] == 1. If 'exclude' is all Ones, the returned
Allocation Tag is '0000'. // // This function is permitted to generate a
non-deterministic selection from the set of non-excluded // Allocation
Tags. A reasonable implementation should select a tag from a uniform
distribution and // avoid common pitfalls such as modulo bias. // //
This function can read RGSR_EL1 and/or write RGSR_EL1 to an
IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value. // If it is not capable of writing
RGSR_EL1.SEED\[15:0\] to zero from a previous nonzero // RGSR_EL1.SEED
value, it is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether the randomness is
significantly // impacted if RGSR_EL1.SEED\[15:0\] is set to zero.
impdef func</span>
<span id="func_ChooseRandomNonExcludedTag_1">ChooseRandomNonExcludedTag(exclude_in
: bits(16)) =\> bits(4) begin return ARBITRARY : bits(4); end;</span>

</div>

<span id="func_EffectiveBADDR_2">EffectiveBADDR(baddr_in : bits(64),
directread : boolean) =\> bits(64) begin var baddr : bits(64) =
baddr_in; // Determine top bit position based on feature support. let n
: integer{} = (if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_LVA3) then 57 else (if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_LVA) then 53 else 49)); // Check if the upper
bits of the base address form a valid sign extension. if baddr\[63:n\]
!= Replicate{64-n}(baddr\[n-1\]) then let c =
ConstrainUnpredictable(</span>[Unpredictable_BADDR_RESS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_BADDR_RESS));
assert c IN
{[Constraint_RESS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_RESS),
[Constraint_ALLRESS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_ALLRESS),
[Constraint_FAULT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_FAULT)};
if c ==
[Constraint_ALLRESS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_ALLRESS)
\|\| (!directread && c ==
[Constraint_RESS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_RESS))
then baddr\[63:n\] = Replicate{64-n}(baddr\[n-1\]); end; // If c ==
Constraint_FAULT, baddr will cause an Address Size fault when used. end;
return baddr; end;

<span id="aarch64.functions.tlbi.AArch64_TLBI_RPA">// AArch64_TLBI_RPA()

[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3);

[TLBIRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TLBIRecord);
var range_bits :
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize);

[TLBIOp_RPA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TLBIOp_RPA);
r.level = level; r.attr =
[TLBI_AllAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TLBI_AllAttr);
// SIZE field case Xt\[47:44\] of when '0000' =\> range_bits = 12; //
4KB when '0001' =\> range_bits = 14; // 16KB when '0010' =\> range_bits
= 16; // 64KB when '0011' =\> range_bits = 21; // 2MB when '0100' =\>
range_bits = 25; // 32MB when '0101' =\> range_bits = 29; // 512MB when
'0110' =\> range_bits = 30; // 1GB when '0111' =\> range_bits = 34; //
16GB when '1000' =\> range_bits = 36; // 64GB when '1001' =\> range_bits

=\> p = 14; when
[PGS_64KB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PGS_64KB)
=\> p = 16; otherwise =\> return; // Reserved encoding, no TLB entries
are required to be invalidated end; if range_bits \< p then range_bits =
p; end; var BaseADDR :
bits([NUM_PABITS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_NUM_PABITS))
= Zeros{}; case GPCCR_EL3().PGS of when '00' =\> BaseADDR\[51:12\] =
Xt\[39:0\]; // 4KB when '10' =\> BaseADDR\[51:14\] = Xt\[39:2\]; // 16KB

IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_D128) &&
[AArch64_PAMax](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_PAMax_0)()

return !IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_LPA2); when '1000' =\> return TRUE;
when '1001' =\> return !IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_LPA2); when '1100' =\>
return TRUE; otherwise =\> return FALSE; end; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="aarch64.functions.tlbi.TLBIPRange"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/functions/tlbi/TLBIPRange

<span id="aarch64.functions.tlbi.TLBIPRange">// TLBIPRange() //
============ // Extract the input address range information from encoded
Xt. func</span> <span id="func_TLBIPRange_2">TLBIPRange(regime :</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
Xt : bits(128)) =\> (boolean, bits(2), bits(64), bits(64)) begin let
valid : boolean = TRUE; var start_address : bits(64) = Zeros{}; var
end_address : bits(64) = Zeros{}; let tg : bits(2) = Xt\[47:46\]; let
scale : integer = UInt(Xt\[45:44\]); let num : integer =
UInt(Xt\[43:39\]); if tg == '00' then return (FALSE, tg, start_address,
end_address); end; let tg_bits :
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize)
=
[TGBits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_TGBits_1)(tg);
// The more-significant bits of the start_address is not updated, // as
they are not used when performing address matching in TLB
start_address\[55:tg_bits\] = Xt\[107:64+(tg_bits-12)\]; let range :
integer = (num+1) \<\< (5\*scale + 1 + tg_bits); end_address =
start_address + range\[63:0\]; if end_address\[55\] !=
start_address\[55\] then // overflow, saturate it end_address =
Replicate{9}(start_address\[55\]) :: Ones{55}; end; return (valid, tg,
start_address, end_address); end;

[HasLargeAddress](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasLargeAddress_1)(regime)
then start_address\[52:16\] = Xt\[36:0\]; start_address\[63:53\] =
Replicate{11}(Xt\[36\]); else start_address\[48:12\] = Xt\[36:0\];
start_address\[63:49\] = Replicate{15}(Xt\[36\]); end; when '10' =\> //
16KB tg_bits = 14; if

then start_address\[52:16\] = Xt\[36:0\]; start_address\[63:53\] =

start_address\[63:51\] = Replicate{13}(Xt\[36\]); end; when '11' =\> //
64KB tg_bits = 16; start_address\[52:16\] = Xt\[36:0\];
start_address\[63:53\] = Replicate{11}(Xt\[36\]); otherwise =\>

next level table of descriptors func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_NextTableBase_6">AArch64_NextTableBase{N}(descriptor
: bits(N), d128 : bit, skl : bits(2), ds : bit, tgx :</span>
[TGx](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TGx))
=\>
bits([NUM_PABITS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_NUM_PABITS))

if d128 == '1' then tablebase\[55:48\] = descriptor\[55:48\]; elsif tgx

([AArch64_PAMax](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_PAMax_0)()

'011' =\> ps = 42; when '100' =\> ps = 44; when '101' =\> ps = 48; when
'110' =\> ps = 52; when '111' =\> ps = 56; end; if d128 == '1' then
max_ps =
[AArch64_PAMax](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_PAMax_0)();

[CacheOp_CleanInvalidate](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CacheOp_CleanInvalidate)

fault.overlay = TRUE; elsif walkparams.cmow == '1' && s1perms.overlay &&
s1perms.ow == '0' then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_Permission](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Permission);
fault.overlay = TRUE; elsif (s1perms.r == '0' && ImpDefBool("Permission
fault on EL0 IC_IVAU execution")) then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_Permission](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Permission);
elsif walkparams.cmow == '1' && s1perms.w == '0' then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_Permission](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Permission);
elsif (walkparams.cmow == '1' && walkparams.hd != '1' && walkparams.pie
== '1' && permissions.ndirty == '1') then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_Permission](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Permission);
fault.dirtybit = TRUE; end; end; elsif IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_GCS) &&
accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_GCS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_GCS)
then if s1perms.gcs == '0' then fault.statuscode =

then fault.statuscode =

fault.dirtybit = TRUE; fault.write = TRUE; end; elsif accdesc.read &&

[Fault_Permission](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Permission);
fault.overlay = TRUE; fault.write = TRUE; elsif accdesc.read &&
s1perms.r == '0' then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_Permission](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_Permission);

fault.write = TRUE; elsif (accdesc.write && accdesc.tagaccess &&
walkstate.memattrs.tags ==
[MemTag_CanonicallyTagged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_MemTag_CanonicallyTagged))

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1ComputePermissions"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/translation/vmsa_faults/AArch64_S1ComputePermissions

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1ComputePermissions">//
AArch64_S1ComputePermissions() // ============================== //
Computes the overall stage 1 permissions func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S1ComputePermissions_4">AArch64_S1ComputePermissions(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
walkstate :
[TTWState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TTWState),
walkparams :
[S1TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1TTWParams),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls)
begin let permissions :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions)
= walkstate.permissions; var s1perms :
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls);
if walkparams.pie == '1' then s1perms =
[AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions_4)(regime,
walkstate, walkparams, accdesc); else s1perms =
[AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions_4)(regime,
walkstate, walkparams, accdesc); end; if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
&&
\![AArch64_S1E0POEnabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1E0POEnabled_2)(regime,
walkparams.nv1) then s1perms.overlay = FALSE; elsif accdesc.el !=
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
&&
\![AArch64_S1POEnabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1POEnabled_1)(regime)
then s1perms.overlay = FALSE; end; if s1perms.overlay then let
s1overlay_perms :
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls)
=
[AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions_3)(regime,
walkstate, accdesc); s1perms.or = s1overlay_perms.or; s1perms.ow =
s1overlay_perms.ow; s1perms.ox = s1overlay_perms.ox; end; if
s1perms.overlay then // If WXN and the overlay X permission is present,
the overlay W permission is removed. s1perms.ow = s1perms.ow AND
NOT(s1perms.wxn AND s1perms.ox); else // If WXN and the W and X
permissions are present, the X permission is removed. // The W and X
permissions are factored into the WXN computation. s1perms.x = s1perms.x
AND NOT(s1perms.wxn); end; return s1perms; end;

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/translation/vmsa_faults/AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions">//
AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions() // =================================
// Computes the stage 1 direct base permissions func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions_4">AArch64_S1DirectBasePermissions(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
walkstate :
[TTWState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TTWState),
walkparams :
[S1TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1TTWParams),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls)
begin var r, w, x, wxn : bit; var pr, pw, px, pwxn : bit; var ur, uw,
ux, uwxn : bit; var permissions :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions)
= walkstate.permissions; var s1perms :
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls);
// Descriptors marked with DBM set have the effective value of AP\[2\]
cleared. // This implies no Permission faults caused by lack of write
permissions are // reported, and the Dirty bit can be set. if
permissions.dbm == '1' && walkparams.hd == '1' then permissions.ap\[2\]
= '0'; end; if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then // Apply leaf permissions case permissions.ap\[2:1\] of when '00'
=\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','0','0'); // Privileged access when '01'
=\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','1','1','1'); // No effect when '10' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','0','0'); // Read-only, privileged access when
'11' =\> (pr,pw,ur,uw) = ('1','0','1','0'); // Read-only end; // Apply
hierarchical permissions case permissions.ap_table of when '00' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = (pr, pw, ur, uw); // No effect when '01' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = (pr, pw,'0','0'); // Privileged access when '10' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = (pr,'0', ur,'0'); // Read-only when '11' =\>
(pr,pw,ur,uw) = (pr,'0','0','0'); // Read-only, privileged access end;
// Locations writable by unprivileged cannot be executed by privileged
px = NOT(permissions.pxn OR permissions.pxn_table OR uw); ux =
NOT(permissions.uxn OR permissions.uxn_table); pwxn = walkparams.wxn AND
pw AND px; uwxn = walkparams.wxn AND uw AND ux; if
(IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAN) && accdesc.pan && !(regime ==
[Regime_EL10](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL10)
&& walkparams.nv1 == '1')) then if (ImpDefBool("SCR_EL3.SIF affects
EPAN") && accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure)
&& walkparams.sif == '1') then ux = '0'; end; if (ImpDefBool("Realm
EL2&0 regime affects EPAN") && accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Realm)
&& regime ==
[Regime_EL20](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL20)
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace !=
[PAS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Realm))
then ux = '0'; end; let pan : bit =
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PAN
AND (ur OR uw OR (walkparams.epan AND ux)); pr = pr AND NOT(pan); pw =
pw AND NOT(pan); end; else // Apply leaf permissions case
permissions.ap\[2\] of when '0' =\> (pr,pw) = ('1','1'); // No effect
when '1' =\> (pr,pw) = ('1','0'); // Read-only end; // Apply
hierarchical permissions case permissions.ap_table\[1\] of when '0' =\>
(pr,pw) = (pr, pw); // No effect when '1' =\> (pr,pw) = (pr,'0'); //
Read-only end; px = NOT(permissions.xn OR permissions.xn_table); pwxn =
walkparams.wxn AND pw AND px; end; (r,w,x,wxn) = if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then (ur,uw,ux,uwxn) else (pr,pw,px,pwxn); // Prevent execution from
Non-secure space by PE in secure state if SIF is set if accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure)
then x = x AND NOT(walkparams.sif); end; // Prevent execution from
non-Root space by Root if accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Root)
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace !=
[PAS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Root)
then x = '0'; end; // Prevent execution from non-Realm space by Realm
EL2 and Realm EL2&0 if (accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Realm)
&& regime IN
{[Regime_EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL2),
[Regime_EL20](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL20)}
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace !=
[PAS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Realm))
then x = '0'; end; s1perms.r = r; s1perms.w = w; s1perms.x = x;
s1perms.gcs = '0'; s1perms.wxn = wxn; s1perms.overlay = TRUE; return
s1perms; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1HasAlignmentFaultDueToMemType">//
AArch64_S1HasAlignmentFaultDueToMemType() //
========================================= // Returns whether stage 1
output fails alignment requirement on data accesses due to memory type
func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S1HasAlignmentFaultDueToMemType_5">AArch64_S1HasAlignmentFaultDueToMemType(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),

accdesc.acqsc \|\| accdesc.acqpc \|\| accdesc.relsc then if (!aligned &&
!([IsWBShareable](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsWBShareable_1)(memattrs)
&&
[AArch64_S1DCacheEnabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1DCacheEnabled_1)(regime))
&&
[ConstrainUnpredictableBool](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ConstrainUnpredictableBool_1)([Unpredictable_LSE2_ALIGNMENT_FAULT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_LSE2_ALIGNMENT_FAULT)))
then return TRUE; end; end; if memattrs.memtype !=

then return FALSE; elsif ((accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_DCZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_DCZero)
&& accdesc.cachetype ==
[CacheType_Tag](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CacheType_Tag))
\|\| accdesc.stzgm) then return
ConstrainUnpredictable([Unpredictable_DEVICETAGSTORE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_DEVICETAGSTORE))
==
[Constraint_FAULT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_FAULT);
elsif accdesc.a32lsmd && ntlsmd == '0' then return memattrs.device !=
[DeviceType_GRE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_DeviceType_GRE);
elsif accdesc.acctype ==
[AccessType_DCZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_DCZero)
then return TRUE; elsif !aligned then return !(ImpDefBool("Device
location supports unaligned access")); else return FALSE; end; end;

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/translation/vmsa_faults/AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions">//
AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions() //
=================================== // Computes the stage 1 indirect
base permissions func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions_4">AArch64_S1IndirectBasePermissions(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
walkstate :
[TTWState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TTWState),
walkparams :
[S1TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1TTWParams),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls)
begin var r, w, x, gcs, wxn, overlay : bit; var pr, pw, px, pgcs, pwxn,
p_overlay : bit; var ur, uw, ux, ugcs, uwxn, u_overlay : bit; let
permissions :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions)
= walkstate.permissions; var s1perms :
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls);
// Apply privileged indirect permissions case permissions.ppi of when
'0000' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); // No access when '0001'
=\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','0','0','0'); // Privileged read when '0010'
=\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('0','0','1','0'); // Privileged execute when
'0011' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','0','1','0'); // Privileged read and
execute when '0100' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved
when '0101' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','1','0','0'); // Privileged read
and write when '0110' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','1','1','0'); //
Privileged read, write and execute when '0111' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) =
('1','1','1','0'); // Privileged read, write and execute when '1000' =\>
(pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','0','0','0'); // Privileged read when '1001' =\>
(pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','0','0','1'); // Privileged read and gcs when
'1010' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','0','1','0'); // Privileged read and
execute when '1011' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved
when '1100' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','1','0','0'); // Privileged read
and write when '1101' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); //
Reserved when '1110' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('1','1','1','0'); //
Privileged read, write and execute when '1111' =\> (pr,pw,px,pgcs) =
('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved end; p_overlay =
NOT(permissions.ppi\[3\]); pwxn = if permissions.ppi == '0110' then '1'
else '0'; var reserved_upi : boolean = FALSE; if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then // Apply unprivileged indirect permissions case permissions.upi of
when '0000' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); // No access when
'0001' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) = ('1','0','0','0'); // Unprivileged read
when '0010' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) = ('0','0','1','0'); // Unprivileged
execute when '0011' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) = ('1','0','1','0'); //
Unprivileged read and execute when '0100' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) =
('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved reserved_upi = TRUE; when '0101' =\>
(ur,uw,ux,ugcs)=('1','1','0','0');// Unprivileged read and write when
'0110' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs)=('1','1','1','0');// Unprivileged read, write
and execute when '0111' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs)=('1','1','1','0');//
Unprivileged read, write and execute when '1000' =\>
(ur,uw,ux,ugcs)=('1','0','0','0');// Unprivileged read when '1001' =\>
(ur,uw,ux,ugcs)=('1','0','0','1');// Unprivileged read and gcs when
'1010' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs)=('1','0','1','0');// Unprivileged read and
execute when '1011' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved
reserved_upi = TRUE; when '1100' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs)
=('1','1','0','0');// Unprivileged read and write when '1101' =\>
(ur,uw,ux,ugcs) =('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved reserved_upi = TRUE;
when '1110' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) =('1','1','1','0');// Unprivileged read,
write // and execute when '1111' =\> (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) =
('0','0','0','0'); // Reserved reserved_upi = TRUE; end; u_overlay =
NOT(permissions.upi\[3\]); uwxn = if permissions.upi == '0110' then '1'
else '0'; // If the decoded permissions has either px or pgcs along with
either uw or ugcs, // then all effective Stage 1 Base Permissions are
set to 0 if ((px == '1' \|\| pgcs == '1') && (uw == '1' \|\| ugcs ==
'1')) then (pr,pw,px,pgcs) = ('0','0','0','0'); (ur,uw,ux,ugcs) =
('0','0','0','0'); end; end; // Prevent execution from Non-secure space
by PE in secure state if accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure)
then pgcs = '0'; if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then ugcs = '0'; end; if walkparams.sif == '1' then px = '0'; if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then ux = '0'; end; end; end; // Prevent execution from non-Root space
by Root if accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Root)
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace !=
[PAS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Root)
then (px, pgcs) = ('0','0'); if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then (ux, ugcs) = ('0','0'); end; end; // Prevent execution from
non-Realm space by Realm EL2 and Realm EL2&0 if (accdesc.ss ==
[SS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Realm)
&& regime IN
{[Regime_EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL2),
[Regime_EL20](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL20)}
&& walkstate.baseaddress.paspace !=
[PAS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Realm))
then (px, pgcs) = ('0','0'); if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then (ux, ugcs) = ('0','0'); end; end; if
([HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
&& IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAN) && accdesc.pan && !(regime ==
[Regime_EL10](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL10)
&& walkparams.nv1 == '1') &&
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PAN
== '1' && !IsZero(permissions.upi)) then if reserved_upi then if
ImpDefBool("PAN applies when S1UnprivBasePerm is reserved") then (pr,pw)
= ('0','0'); end; elsif (!IsZero(ur::uw::ux::ugcs) \|\| ImpDefBool("PAN
applies when S1UnprivBasePerms are removed")) then (pr,pw) = ('0','0');
end; end; if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then (r,w,x,gcs,wxn,overlay) = (ur,uw,ux,ugcs,uwxn,u_overlay); else
(r,w,x,gcs,wxn,overlay) = (pr,pw,px,pgcs,pwxn,p_overlay); end; s1perms.r
= r; s1perms.w = w; s1perms.x = x; s1perms.gcs = gcs; s1perms.wxn = wxn;
s1perms.overlay = overlay == '1'; return s1perms; end;

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/translation/vmsa_faults/AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions">//
AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions() // ============================== //
Computes the stage 1 overlay permissions func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions_3">AArch64_S1OverlayPermissions(regime
:</span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
walkstate :
[TTWState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TTWState),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls)
begin var r, w, x : bit; var pr, pw, px : bit; var ur, uw, ux : bit; let
permissions :
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions)
= walkstate.permissions; var s1overlay_perms :
[S1AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1AccessControls);
let por : S1PORType =
[AArch64_S1POR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_S1POR_1)(regime);
let bit_index : integer{} = 4 \* UInt(permissions.po_index); let ppo :
bits(4) = por\[bit_index+3:bit_index\]; // Apply privileged overlay
permissions case ppo of when '0000' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('0','0','0'); //
No access when '0001' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('1','0','0'); // Privileged read
when '0010' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('0','0','1'); // Privileged execute when
'0011' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('1','0','1'); // Privileged read and execute
when '0100' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('0','1','0'); // Privileged write when
'0101' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('1','1','0'); // Privileged read and write when
'0110' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('0','1','1'); // Privileged write and execute
when '0111' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('1','1','1'); // Privileged read, write
and execute when '1xxx' =\> (pr,pw,px) = ('0','0','0'); // Reserved end;
if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then var upo : bits(4) = '0000'; if
!([HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
&& SCR_EL3().PIEn == '0' && ImpDefBool("SCR_EL3.PIEn forces PIR_ELx or
POR_ELx to zero")) then upo = POR_EL0()\[bit_index+3:bit_index\]; end;
// Apply unprivileged overlay permissions case upo of when '0000' =\>
(ur,uw,ux) = ('0','0','0'); // No access when '0001' =\> (ur,uw,ux) =
('1','0','0'); // Unprivileged read when '0010' =\> (ur,uw,ux) =
('0','0','1'); // Unprivileged execute when '0011' =\> (ur,uw,ux) =
('1','0','1'); // Unprivileged read and execute when '0100' =\>
(ur,uw,ux) = ('0','1','0'); // Unprivileged write when '0101' =\>
(ur,uw,ux) = ('1','1','0'); // Unprivileged read and write when '0110'
=\> (ur,uw,ux) = ('0','1','1'); // Unprivileged write and execute when
'0111' =\> (ur,uw,ux) = ('1','1','1'); // Unprivileged read, write and
execute when '1xxx' =\> (ur,uw,ux) = ('0','0','0'); // Reserved end;
end; (r,w,x) = if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then (ur,uw,ux) else (pr,pw,px); s1overlay_perms.or = r;
s1overlay_perms.ow = w; s1overlay_perms.ox = x; return s1overlay_perms;
end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S2DirectBasePermissions">//
AArch64_S2DirectBasePermissions() // =================================
// Computes the stage 2 direct base permissions. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S2DirectBasePermissions_3">AArch64_S2DirectBasePermissions(permissions
:</span>
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor),
walkparams :
[S2TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2TTWParams))
=\>
[S2AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2AccessControls)
begin var s2perms :
[S2AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2AccessControls);
var w : bit; let r : bit = permissions.s2ap\[0\]; if
permissions.s2ap\[1\] == '1' then w = '1'; // Descriptors marked with
DBM set have the effective value of S2AP\[1\] set. // This implies no
Permission faults caused by lack of write permissions are // reported,
and the Dirty bit can be set. elsif permissions.dbm == '1' &&
walkparams.hd == '1' then // An update occurs here, conditional to being
able to append to HDBSS if walkparams.hdbss == '1' then w = if
[CanAppendToHDBSS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CanAppendToHDBSS_0)()
then '1' else '0'; else w = '1'; end; else w = '0'; end; var px, ux :
bit; case (permissions.s2xn::permissions.s2xnx) of when '00' =\> (px,ux)
= ('1','1'); when '01' =\> (px,ux) = ('0','1'); when '10' =\> (px,ux) =
('0','0'); when '11' =\> (px,ux) = ('1','0'); end; let x : bit = if
accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then ux else px; s2perms.r = r; s2perms.w = w; s2perms.x = x;
s2perms.r_rcw = r; s2perms.w_rcw = w; s2perms.r_mmu = r; s2perms.w_mmu =
w; s2perms.toplevel0 = '0'; s2perms.toplevel1 = '0'; s2perms.overlay =
FALSE; return s2perms; end;

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S2IndirectBasePermissions">//
AArch64_S2IndirectBasePermissions() //
=================================== // Computes the stage 2 indirect
base permissions. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S2IndirectBasePermissions_2">AArch64_S2IndirectBasePermissions(permissions
:</span>
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[S2AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2AccessControls)
begin var r, w : bit; var r_rcw, w_rcw : bit; var r_mmu, w_mmu : bit;
var px, ux : bit; var toplevel0, toplevel1 : bit; var s2perms :
[S2AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2AccessControls);
let s2pi : bits(4) = permissions.s2pi; case s2pi of when '0000' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('0','0','0','0','0','0'); // No Access when
'0001' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('0','0','0','0','0','0'); //
Reserved when '0010' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','0','0','0','1','1'); // MRO when '0011' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','1','1'); // MRO-TL1 when
'0100' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('0','1','0','0','0','0'); // Write
Only when '0101' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('0','0','0','0','0','0'); // Reserved when '0110' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','1','1'); // MRO-TL0 when
'0111' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','1','1'); //
MRO-TL01 when '1000' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','0','0','0','0','0'); // Read Only when '1001' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','1','0','0'); // Read, Unpriv
Execute when '1010' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','0','1','0','0','0'); // Read, Priv Execute when '1011' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','1','1','0','0'); // Read, All
Execute when '1100' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','1','0','0','1','1'); // RW when '1101' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu)
= ('1','1','0','1','1','1'); // RW, Unpriv Execute when '1110' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','1','1','0','1','1'); // RW, Priv Execute
when '1111' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','1','1','1','1','1'); //
RW, All Execute end; let x : bit = if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then ux else px; // RCW and MMU read permissions. (r_rcw, r_mmu) = (r,
r); // Stage 2 Top Level Permission Attributes. case s2pi of when '0110'
=\> (toplevel0,toplevel1) = ('1','0'); when '0011' =\>
(toplevel0,toplevel1) = ('0','1'); when '0111' =\> (toplevel0,toplevel1)
= ('1','1'); otherwise =\> (toplevel0,toplevel1) = ('0','0'); end;
s2perms.r = r; s2perms.w = w; s2perms.x = x; s2perms.r_rcw = r_rcw;
s2perms.r_mmu = r_mmu; s2perms.w_rcw = w_rcw; s2perms.w_mmu = w_mmu;
s2perms.toplevel0 = toplevel0; s2perms.toplevel1 = toplevel1; return
s2perms; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S2OverlayPermissions"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/translation/vmsa_faults/AArch64_S2OverlayPermissions

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_S2OverlayPermissions">//
AArch64_S2OverlayPermissions() // ============================== //
Computes the stage 2 overlay permissions. func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S2OverlayPermissions_2">AArch64_S2OverlayPermissions(permissions
:</span>
[Permissions](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Permissions),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[S2AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2AccessControls)
begin var r, w : bit; var r_rcw, w_rcw : bit; var r_mmu, w_mmu : bit;
var px, ux : bit; var toplevel0, toplevel1 : bit; var s2overlay_perms :
[S2AccessControls](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S2AccessControls);
let index : integer{} = 4 \* UInt(permissions.s2po_index); var s2po :
bits(4) = '0000'; if
!([HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
&& SCR_EL3().PIEn == '0' && ImpDefBool("SCR_EL3.PIEn forces PIR_ELx or
POR_ELx to zero")) then s2po = S2POR_EL1()\[index+3:index\]; end; case
s2po of when '0000' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('0','0','0','0','0','0'); // No Access when '0001' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('0','0','0','0','0','0'); // Reserved when
'0010' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','1','1'); // MRO
when '0011' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','1','1'); //
MRO-TL1 when '0100' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('0','1','0','0','0','0'); // Write Only when '0101' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('0','0','0','0','0','0'); // Reserved when
'0110' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','1','1'); //
MRO-TL0 when '0111' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','0','0','0','1','1'); // MRO-TL01 when '1000' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','0','0','0'); // Read Only when
'1001' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','0','1','0','0'); // Read,
Unpriv Execute when '1010' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','0','1','0','0','0'); // Read, Priv Execute when '1011' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','0','1','1','0','0'); // Read, All
Execute when '1100' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) =
('1','1','0','0','1','1'); // RW when '1101' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu)
= ('1','1','0','1','1','1'); // RW, Unpriv Execute when '1110' =\>
(r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','1','1','0','1','1'); // RW, Priv Execute
when '1111' =\> (r,w,px,ux,w_rcw,w_mmu) = ('1','1','1','1','1','1'); //
RW, All Execute end; let x : bit = if accdesc.el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then ux else px; // RCW and MMU read permissions. (r_rcw, r_mmu) = (r,
r); // Stage 2 Top Level Permission Attributes. case s2po of when '0110'
=\> (toplevel0,toplevel1) = ('1','0'); when '0011' =\>
(toplevel0,toplevel1) = ('0','1'); when '0111' =\> (toplevel0,toplevel1)
= ('1','1'); otherwise =\> (toplevel0,toplevel1) = ('0','0'); end;
s2overlay_perms.or = r; s2overlay_perms.ow = w; s2overlay_perms.ox = x;
s2overlay_perms.or_rcw = r_rcw; s2overlay_perms.ow_rcw = w_rcw;
s2overlay_perms.or_mmu = r_mmu; s2overlay_perms.ow_mmu = w_mmu;
s2overlay_perms.toplevel0 = toplevel0; s2overlay_perms.toplevel1 =
toplevel1; return s2overlay_perms; end;

</div>

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_faults.AArch64_VAIsOutOfRange">//
AArch64_VAIsOutOfRange() // ======================== // Check bits not
resolved by translation are identical and of accepted value func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_VAIsOutOfRange_4">AArch64_VAIsOutOfRange(va_in :
bits(64), acctype :</span>
[AccessType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessType),
regime :
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
walkparams :
[S1TTWParams](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_S1TTWParams))
=\> boolean begin var va : bits(64) = va_in; let addrtop :
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize)
=
[AArch64_AddrTop](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_AddrTop_3)(walkparams.tbid,
acctype, walkparams.tbi); // If the VA has a Logical Address Tag then
the bits holding the Logical Address Tag are // ignored when checking if
the address is out of range. if walkparams.mtx == '1' && acctype !=
[AccessType_IFETCH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IFETCH)
then va\[59:56\] = if
[AArch64_GetVARange](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_GetVARange_1)(va)
==
[VARange_UPPER](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_VARange_UPPER)
then '1111' else '0000'; end; // Input Address size let iasize :
integer{} =
[AArch64_IASize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_IASize_1)(walkparams.txsz);
// The min value of TxSZ can be 8, with LVA3 implemented. // If TxSZ is
set to 8 iasize becomes 64 - 8 = 56 // If tbi is also set, addrtop
becomes 55 // Then the return statements check va\[56:55\] // The check
here is to guard against this corner case. if addrtop \< iasize then
return FALSE; end; if
[HasUnprivileged](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HasUnprivileged_1)(regime)
then if
[AArch64_GetVARange](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_GetVARange_1)(va)
==
[VARange_LOWER](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_VARange_LOWER)
then return !IsZero(va\[addrtop:iasize\]); else return
!IsOnes(va\[addrtop:iasize\]); end; else return
!IsZero(va\[addrtop:iasize\]); end; end;

memattrs.outer.attrs =

if (s1_memattrs.memtype ==

s2_shareability); memattrs.tags =

<span id="func_AArch64_MemSwapTableDesc_7">AArch64_MemSwapTableDesc{N :
integer{64, 128}}(fault_in :</span>
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord),
prev_desc : bits(N), new_desc : bits(N), ee : bit, descaccess :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor),
descpaddr :
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor)
) =\>
([FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord),
bits(N)) begin assert descaccess.acctype ==
[AccessType_TTW](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_TTW);
var fault :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
= fault_in; var iswrite : boolean; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME)
then fault.gpcf =
[GranuleProtectionCheck](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_GranuleProtectionCheck_2)(descpaddr,
descaccess); if fault.gpcf.gpf !=
[GPCF_None](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_GPCF_None)
then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_GPCFOnWalk](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_GPCFOnWalk);
fault.paddress = descpaddr.paddress; fault.gpcfs2walk =
fault.secondstage; return (fault, ARBITRARY : bits(N)); end; end; // All
observers in the shareability domain observe the // following memory
read and write accesses atomically. var mem_desc : bits(N); var
memstatus :
[PhysMemRetStatus](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PhysMemRetStatus);
(memstatus, mem_desc) =
[PhysMemRead](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PhysMemRead_3){N}(descpaddr,
descaccess); if ee == '1' then mem_desc =
[BigEndianReverse](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_BigEndianReverse_2){N}(mem_desc);
end; if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(memstatus)
then iswrite = FALSE; fault =
[HandleExternalTTWAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HandleExternalTTWAbort_6)(memstatus,
iswrite, descpaddr, descaccess, N DIV 8, fault); if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(fault.statuscode)
then return (fault, ARBITRARY : bits(N)); end; end; if mem_desc ==
prev_desc then let ordered_new_desc : bits(N) = (if ee == '1' then
[BigEndianReverse](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_BigEndianReverse_2){N}(new_desc)
else new_desc); memstatus =
[PhysMemWrite](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PhysMemWrite_4){N}(descpaddr,
descaccess, ordered_new_desc); if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(memstatus)
then iswrite = TRUE; fault =
[HandleExternalTTWAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HandleExternalTTWAbort_6)(memstatus,
iswrite, descpaddr, descaccess, N DIV 8, fault); if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(fault.statuscode)
then return (fault, ARBITRARY : bits(N)); end; end; // Reflect what is
now in memory (in little endian format) mem_desc = new_desc; end; return
(fault, mem_desc); end;

&& accdesc.acctype !=
[AccessType_IFETCH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_AccessType_IFETCH)

accdesc, size); end; if (IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME) &&
\![IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(result)

[SPESampleInFlight](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_SPESampleInFlight)
&& !(accdesc.acctype IN

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_ttentry.AArch64_ContiguousBit"></span>

### Library pseudocode for aarch64/translation/vmsa_ttentry/AArch64_ContiguousBit

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_ttentry.AArch64_ContiguousBit">//
AArch64_ContiguousBit() // ======================= // Get the value of
the contiguous bit func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_ContiguousBit_5">AArch64_ContiguousBit{N}(tgx
:</span>
[TGx](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TGx),
d128 : bit, level : integer, descriptor : bits(N)) =\> bit begin if
ImpDefBool("Treat Contiguous bit as 0") then return '0'; end; if d128 ==
'1' then if (tgx ==
[TGx_64KB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TGx_64KB)
&& level == 1) \|\| (tgx ==
[TGx_4KB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TGx_4KB)
&& level == 0) then return '0'; // RES0 else return descriptor\[111\];
end; end; // When using TGx 64KB then the Contiguous bit is RES0 for
Block // descriptors at level 1. For VMSAv8-64, level 1 Block
descriptors // can exist only if FEAT_LPA is implemented. if tgx ==
[TGx_64KB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TGx_64KB)
&& level == 1 then return '0'; // RES0 end; // When the Effective value
of TCR_ELx.DS is '1', // the Contiguous bit is RES0 for all the
following: // \* For TGx 4KB, Block descriptors at level 0 // \* For TGx
16KB, Block descriptors at level 1 // For VMSAv8-64, the above Block
descriptors at the specified // levels can exist only if the Effective
value of TCR_ELx.DS is 1. if tgx ==
[TGx_16KB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TGx_16KB)
&& level == 1 then return '0'; // RES0 end; if tgx ==
[TGx_4KB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_TGx_4KB)
&& level == 0 then return '0'; // RES0 end; return descriptor\[52\];
end;

</div>

then return
[DescriptorType_Leaf](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_DescriptorType_Leaf);

output permissions encoded in stage 1 page/block descriptors func</span>
<span id="func_AArch64_S1ApplyOutputPerms_5">AArch64_S1ApplyOutputPerms{N}(permissions_in

<span id="aarch64.translation.vmsa_ttentry.AArch64_nTFaults">//

<span id="func_AArch64_nTFaults_3">AArch64_nTFaults{N}(d128 : bit,

<span id="func_Write_EDITR_2">Write_EDITR(memory_mapped : boolean, value
: bits(32)) begin if EDSCR().ERR == '1' then return; end; // Error flag
set: ignore write if
!</span>[Halted](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_Halted_0)()
then return; end; // Non-debug state: ignore write if EDSCR().ITE == '0'
\|\| EDSCR().MA == '1' then EDSCR().ITO = '1'; EDSCR().ERR = '1'; //
Overrun condition: block write return; end; // ITE indicates whether the
PE is ready to accept another instruction; the PE // may support
multiple outstanding instructions. Unlike the "InstrCompl" flag in
\[v7A\] there // is no indication that the pipeline is empty (all
instructions have completed). In this // pseudocode, the assumption is
that only one instruction can be executed at a time, // meaning ITE acts
like "InstrCompl". EDSCR().ITE = '0'; if
\![UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
then ExecuteA64(value); else ExecuteT32(value\[15:0\]/\*hw1\*/,
value\[31:16\] /\*hw2\*/); end; EDSCR().ITE = '1'; return; end;

External Debug Request debug event. // - Generate a BRBE freeze event.
func</span> <span id="func_CheckForPMUOverflow_0">CheckForPMUOverflow()

let include_r3 : boolean = TRUE; let enabled : boolean =</span>
[PMUInterruptEnabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PMUInterruptEnabled_0)();
let pmuirq : boolean =

include_r1, include_r2, include_r3);
SetInterruptRequestLevel([InterruptID_PMUIRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_InterruptID_PMUIRQ),
if enabled && pmuirq then
[HIGH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_HIGH)
else
[LOW](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_LOW));
CTI_SetEventLevel([CrossTriggerIn_PMUOverflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_CrossTriggerIn_PMUOverflow),
if pmuirq then
[HIGH](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_HIGH)
else
[LOW](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_LOW));
if
[ShouldBRBEFreeze](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ShouldBRBEFreeze_0)()
then
[BRBEFreeze](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_BRBEFreeze_0)();
end; return; end;

[PMUOverflowCondition_Freeze](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PMUOverflowCondition_Freeze)
=\> check_e = FALSE; check_inten = FALSE; exclude_cyc = TRUE; when
[PMUOverflowCondition_IRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PMUOverflowCondition_IRQ),
[PMUOverflowCondition_EDBGRQ](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PMUOverflowCondition_EDBGRQ)
=\> check_e = TRUE; check_inten = TRUE; exclude_cyc = FALSE; otherwise
=\> unreachable; end; var ovsf : bits(64); if
[HaveAArch64](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveAArch64_0)()
then ovsf = PMOVSSET_EL0(); ovsf\[63:33\] = Zeros{31}; if
!IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PMUv3_ICNTR) then
ovsf\[[INSTRUCTION_COUNTER_ID](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_INSTRUCTION_COUNTER_ID)\]
= '0'; end; else ovsf = ZeroExtend{64}(PMOVSSET()); end; let counters :

bit; case
[GetPMUCounterRange](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_GetPMUCounterRange_1)(idx)
of when
[PMUCounterRange_R1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PMUCounterRange_R1)

end; when

end; case statuscode of when

<span id="shared.functions.cache.DecodeSW"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/cache/DecodeSW

<span id="shared.functions.cache.DecodeSW">// DecodeSW() // ==========
// Decode input value into setnum, waynum and level for SW instructions.
func</span> <span id="func_DecodeSW_2">DecodeSW(regval : bits(64),
cachetype :</span>
[CacheType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_CacheType))
=\> (integer, integer, integer) begin let level : integer =
UInt(regval\[3:1\]); let (numsets, associativity, linesize) =
[GetCacheInfo](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_GetCacheInfo_2)(level,
cachetype); // For the given level and cachetype, get the number of
sets, associativity and // cache line size in terms of actual bytes. let
max_waybits : integer{} = if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_CCIDX) then 21
else 10; let max_setbits : integer{} = if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_CCIDX) then 24 else 15; let waybits :
integer{} = CeilLog2(associativity) as integer{0..max_waybits}; let
setbits : integer{} = CeilLog2(numsets) as integer{0..max_setbits}; let
linebits : integer{} = FloorLog2(linesize) as integer{4..11}; let waynum
: integer = if associativity == 1 then 0 else
UInt(regval\[31:32-waybits\]); let setnum : integer = if numsets == 1
then 0 else UInt(regval\[linebits +: setbits\]); return (setnum, waynum,
level); end;

</div>

:</span>

=\> (integer, integer, integer) begin let numsets : integer =
ImpDefInt("Numsets for DC SW instructions"); let associativity : integer
= ImpDefInt("Associativity for DC SW instructions"); let linesize :
integer = ImpDefInt("Linesize for DC SW instructions"); return (numsets,
associativity, linesize); end;

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/common/Reverse

<span id="shared.functions.common.Reverse">// Reverse() // ========= //
Reverse subwords of M bits in an N-bit word func</span>
<span id="func_Reverse_3">Reverse{N}(word : bits(N), M : integer) =\>
bits(N) begin assert N MOD M == 0; var result : bits(N); let swsize :
integer{} = M as integer{1..N}; let sw : integer = N DIV swsize; for s =
0 to sw-1 do result\[((sw - 1) - s)\*:swsize\] = word\[s\*:swsize\];
end; return result; end;</span>

</div>

============ // Poly32Mod2 on a bitstring does a polynomial Modulus over
{0,1} operation func</span>
<span id="func_Poly32Mod2_3">Poly32Mod2{N}(data_in : bits(N), poly :
bits(32)) =\> bits(32) begin assert N \> 32; var data : bits(N) =
data_in; for i = N-1 downto 32 do if data\[i\] == '1' then data\[i-1:0\]
= data\[i-1:0\] XOR (poly::Zeros{i-32}); end; end; return data\[31:0\];
end;</span>
