### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/crypto/SHA256hash

<span id="shared.functions.crypto.SHA256hash">// SHA256hash() //
============ func</span> <span id="func_SHA256hash_4">SHA256hash(x_in :
bits (128), y_in : bits(128), w : bits(128), part1 : boolean) =\>
bits(128) begin var chs, maj, t : bits(32); var x : bits(128) = x_in;
var y : bits(128) = y_in; for e = 0 to 3 do chs =</span>
[SHAchoose](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SHAchoose_3)(y\[31:0\],
y\[63:32\], y\[95:64\]); maj =
[SHAmajority](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SHAmajority_4){32}(x\[31:0\],
x\[63:32\], x\[95:64\]); t = y\[127:96\] +
[SHA256hashSIGMA1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SHA256hashSIGMA1_1)(y\[31:0\]) +
chs + w\[e\*:32\]; x\[127:96\] = t + x\[127:96\]; y\[127:96\] = t +
[SHA256hashSIGMA0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_SHA256hashSIGMA0_1)(x\[31:0\]) +
maj; let yx : bits(256) = ROL(y :: x, 32); (y, x) = (yx\[128+:128\],
yx\[0+:128\]); end; return (if part1 then x else y); end;

ExternalFault() // =============== // Return a fault recording
indicating a fault for a Synchronous/Asynchronous External abort.
func</span> <span id="func_ExternalFault_5">ExternalFault(memretstatus
:</span>
[PhysMemRetStatus](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PhysMemRetStatus),
iswrite : boolean, memaddrdesc :
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor),
size : integer, accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor))
=\>
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
begin assert (memretstatus.statuscode IN
{[Fault_SyncExternal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncExternal),
[Fault_AsyncExternal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_AsyncExternal)}
\|\| (!IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RAS) && memretstatus.statuscode IN
{[Fault_SyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncParity),
[Fault_AsyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_AsyncParity)}));
var fault :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
=
[NoFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_NoFault_2)(accdesc,
memaddrdesc.vaddress); fault.statuscode = memretstatus.statuscode;
fault.write = iswrite; fault.extflag = memretstatus.extflag; // It is
implementation specific whether External aborts signaled // in-band
synchronously are taken synchronously or asynchronously if
([IsExternalSyncAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalSyncAbort_1)(fault)
&& ((IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RASv2) &&
[ExtAbortToAArch64](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ExtAbortToAArch64_1)(fault)
&&
[PEErrorState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PEErrorState_1)(fault)
IN
{[ErrorState_UC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_ErrorState_UC),
[ErrorState_UEU](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_ErrorState_UEU)})
\|\|
\![IsExternalAbortTakenSynchronously](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalAbortTakenSynchronously_5)(memretstatus,
iswrite, memaddrdesc, size, accdesc))) then if fault.statuscode ==
[Fault_SyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncParity)
then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_AsyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_AsyncParity);
else fault.statuscode =
[Fault_AsyncExternal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_AsyncExternal);
end; end; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RAS) then fault.merrorstate =
memretstatus.merrorstate; end; fault.paddress = memaddrdesc.paddress;
return fault; end;

<span id="shared.functions.externalaborts.HandleExternalTTWAbort">//
HandleExternalTTWAbort() // ======================== // Take
Asynchronous abort or update FaultRecord for Translation Table Walk //
based on PhysMemRetStatus. func</span>
<span id="func_HandleExternalTTWAbort_6">HandleExternalTTWAbort(memretstatus
:</span>
[PhysMemRetStatus](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PhysMemRetStatus),
iswrite : boolean, memaddrdesc :
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor),
accdesc :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor),
size : integer, input_fault :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord))
=\>
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
begin var output_fault :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
= input_fault; output_fault.extflag = memretstatus.extflag;
output_fault.statuscode = memretstatus.statuscode; if
([IsExternalSyncAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalSyncAbort_1)(output_fault)
&& ((IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RASv2) &&
[ExtAbortToAArch64](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ExtAbortToAArch64_1)(output_fault)
&&
[PEErrorState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PEErrorState_1)(output_fault)
IN
{[ErrorState_UC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_ErrorState_UC),
[ErrorState_UEU](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_ErrorState_UEU)})
\|\|
\![IsExternalAbortTakenSynchronously](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalAbortTakenSynchronously_5)(memretstatus,
iswrite, memaddrdesc, size, accdesc))) then if output_fault.statuscode
==
[Fault_SyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncParity)
then output_fault.statuscode =
[Fault_AsyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_AsyncParity);
else output_fault.statuscode =
[Fault_AsyncExternal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_AsyncExternal);
end; end; // If a synchronous fault is on a translation table walk, then
update the fault type. if
[IsExternalSyncAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalSyncAbort_1)(output_fault)
then if output_fault.statuscode ==
[Fault_SyncParity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncParity)
then output_fault.statuscode =
[Fault_SyncParityOnWalk](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncParityOnWalk);
else output_fault.statuscode =
[Fault_SyncExternalOnWalk](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_SyncExternalOnWalk);
end; end; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RAS) then
output_fault.merrorstate = memretstatus.merrorstate; end; if
\![IsExternalSyncAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsExternalSyncAbort_1)(output_fault)
then PendSErrorInterrupt(output_fault); output_fault.statuscode =
[Fault_None](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_None);
end; output_fault.paddress = memaddrdesc.paddress; return output_fault;
end;

addition following computational behaviors // corresponding to

<span id="func_BFAdd_5">BFAdd{N}(op1 : bits(N), op2 : bits(N), fpcr :

[FPRoundingMode](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPRoundingMode_1)(fpcr);

(type1,sign1,value1) =

[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_4){2\*N}(op2_s,

[FPProcessNaNs](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessNaNs_7){2\*N}(type1,
type2, op1_s, op2_s, fpcr, fpexc); if !done then let inf1 = (type1 ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity));
let inf2 = (type2 ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity));
let zero1 = (type1 ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));
let zero2 = (type2 ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));

[FPDefaultNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPDefaultNaN_2){2\*N}(fpcr);

elsif zero1 && zero2 && sign1 == sign2 then result =
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){2\*N}(sign1);
else let result_value : real = value1 + value2; if result_value == 0.0

[FPRounding_NEGINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_NEGINF)

fpcr, rounding, fpexc); end; end; if fpexc then
[FPProcessDenorms](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessDenorms_4)(type1,
type2, 2\*N, fpcr); end; end; return result\[2\*N-1:N\]; end;

<span id="func_BFClampScale_2">BFClampScale(op : bits(16), scale_in :

<span id="shared.functions.float.bfloat.BFUnpack"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/bfloat/BFUnpack

<span id="shared.functions.float.bfloat.BFUnpack">// BFUnpack() //
========== // Unpacks a BFloat16 or single-precision value into its
type, // sign bit and real number that it represents. // The real number
result has the correct sign for numbers and infinities, // is very large
in magnitude for infinities, and is 0.0 for NaNs. // (These values are
chosen to simplify the description of // comparisons and conversions.)
func</span> <span id="func_BFUnpack_2">BFUnpack{N}(fpval : bits(N)) =\>
(</span>[FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType),
bit, real) begin assert N IN {16,32}; var sign : bit; var exp : bits(8);
var frac : bits(23); if N == 16 then sign = fpval\[15\]; exp =
fpval\[14:7\]; frac = fpval\[6:0\] :: Zeros{16}; else // N == 32 sign =
fpval\[31\]; exp = fpval\[30:23\]; frac = fpval\[22:0\]; end; var fptype
:
[FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType);
var value : real; if IsZero(exp) then fptype =
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero);
value = 0.0; // Fixed Flush to Zero elsif IsOnes(exp) then if
IsZero(frac) then fptype =
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity);
value = 2.0^1000000; else // no SNaN for BF16 arithmetic fptype =
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN);
value = 0.0; end; else fptype =
[FPType_Nonzero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Nonzero);
value = 2.0^(UInt(exp)-127) \* (1.0 + Real(UInt(frac)) \* 2.0^-23); end;
if sign == '1' then value = -value; end; return (fptype, sign, value);
end;

</div>

[FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3);
otherwise =\> return
[FP8Type_UNSUPPORTED](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_UNSUPPORTED);
end; end;

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/fp8float/FP8DotAddFP

<span id="shared.functions.float.fp8float.FP8DotAddFP">// FP8DotAddFP()
// ============= func</span>
<span id="func_FP8DotAddFP_7">FP8DotAddFP{M, N}(addend : bits(M), op1 :
bits(N), op2 : bits(N), fpcr : FPCR_Type, fpmr : FPMR_Type) =\> bits(M)
begin let E : integer{} = (N DIV 8) as integer{1, 2, 4, 8};
return</span>
[FP8DotAddFP](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8DotAddFP_8){M,
N}(addend, op1, op2, E, fpcr, fpmr); end; // FP8DotAddFP() //
============== // Calculates result of "E"-way 8-bit floating-point
dot-product with scaling // and addition to half-precision or
single-precision value without // intermediate rounding. // c =
round(c + 2^-S\*(a1\*b1+..+aE\*bE)) // The 8-bit floating-point format
for op1 is determined by FPMR.F8S1 // and the one for op2 by FPMR.F8S2.
The scaling factor in FPMR.LSCALE // is applied to the sum-of-products
before adding to the addend and rounding. func
<span id="func_FP8DotAddFP_8">FP8DotAddFP{M, N}(addend : bits(M), op1 :
bits(N), op2 : bits(N), E : integer{1, 2, 4, 8}, fpcr_in : FPCR_Type,
fpmr : FPMR_Type) =\> bits(M) begin assert M IN {16,32}; assert N IN
{2\*M, M, M DIV 2, M DIV 4}; var fpcr : FPCR_Type = fpcr_in; var result
: bits(M); fpcr.\[FIZ,FZ,FZ16\] = '000'; // Do not flush denormal inputs
and outputs to zero fpcr.DN = '1'; let rounding =</span>
[FPRounding_TIEEVEN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_TIEEVEN);
let fp8type1 :
[FP8Type](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FP8Type)
=
[FP8DecodeType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8DecodeType_1)(fpmr.F8S1);
let fp8type2 :
[FP8Type](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FP8Type)
=
[FP8DecodeType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8DecodeType_1)(fpmr.F8S2);
var type1 : array\[\[E\]\] of
[FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType);
var type2 : array\[\[E\]\] of
[FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType);
var sign1 : array\[\[E\]\] of bit; var sign2 : array\[\[E\]\] of bit;
var value1 : array\[\[E\]\] of real; var value2 : array\[\[E\]\] of
real; var inf1 : array\[\[E\]\] of boolean; var inf2 : array\[\[E\]\] of
boolean; var zero1 : array\[\[E\]\] of boolean; var zero2 :
array\[\[E\]\] of boolean; let fpexc : boolean = FALSE; let
(typeA,signA,valueA) =
[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_4){M}(addend,
fpcr, fpexc); let infA = (typeA ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity));
let zeroA = (typeA ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));
var any_nan : boolean = typeA IN
{[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN),
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)};
for i = 0 to E-1 do (type1\[\[i\]\], sign1\[\[i\]\], value1\[\[i\]\]) =
[FP8Unpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Unpack_3){N
DIV E}(op1\[i\*:(N DIV E)\], fp8type1); (type2\[\[i\]\], sign2\[\[i\]\],
value2\[\[i\]\]) =
[FP8Unpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Unpack_3){N
DIV E}(op2\[i\*:(N DIV E)\], fp8type2); inf1\[\[i\]\] = (type1\[\[i\]\]
==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity));
zero1\[\[i\]\] = (type1\[\[i\]\] ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));
inf2\[\[i\]\] = (type2\[\[i\]\] ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity));
zero2\[\[i\]\] = (type2\[\[i\]\] ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));
any_nan = (any_nan \|\| type1\[\[i\]\] IN
{[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN),
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)}
\|\| type2\[\[i\]\] IN
{[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN),
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)});
end; if any_nan then result =
[FPDefaultNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPDefaultNaN_2){M}(fpcr);
else // Determine sign and type products will have if it does not cause
an Invalid // Operation. var signP : array \[\[E\]\] of bit; var infP :
array \[\[E\]\] of boolean; var zeroP : array \[\[E\]\] of boolean; for
i = 0 to E-1 do signP\[\[i\]\] = sign1\[\[i\]\] XOR sign2\[\[i\]\];
infP\[\[i\]\] = inf1\[\[i\]\] \|\| inf2\[\[i\]\]; zeroP\[\[i\]\] =
zero1\[\[i\]\] \|\| zero2\[\[i\]\]; end; // Detect non-numeric results
of dot product and accumulate var posInfR : boolean = (infA && signA ==
'0'); var negInfR : boolean = (infA && signA == '1'); var zeroR :
boolean = zeroA; var invalidop : boolean = FALSE; for i = 0 to E-1 do //
Result is infinity if any input is infinity posInfR = posInfR \|\|
(infP\[\[i\]\] && signP\[\[i\]\] == '0'); negInfR = negInfR \|\|
(infP\[\[i\]\] && signP\[\[i\]\] == '1'); // Result is zero if the
addend and the products are zeroes of the same sign zeroR = zeroR &&
zeroP\[\[i\]\] && (signA == signP\[\[i\]\]); // Non SNaN-generated
Invalid Operation cases are multiplies of zero // by infinity and
additions of opposite-signed infinities. invalidop = (invalidop \|\|
(inf1\[\[i\]\] && zero2\[\[i\]\]) \|\| (zero1\[\[i\]\] && inf2\[\[i\]\])
\|\| (infA && infP\[\[i\]\] && (signA != signP\[\[i\]\]))); for j = i+1
to E-1 do invalidop = invalidop \|\| (infP\[\[i\]\] && infP\[\[j\]\] &&
(signP\[\[i\]\] != signP\[\[j\]\])); end; end; if invalidop then result
=
[FPDefaultNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPDefaultNaN_2){M}(fpcr);
// Other cases involving infinities produce an infinity of the same
sign. elsif posInfR then result =
[FPInfinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPInfinity_2){M}('0');
elsif negInfR then result =
[FPInfinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPInfinity_2){M}('1');
// Cases where the result is exactly zero and its sign is not determined
by the // rounding mode are additions of same-signed zeros. elsif zeroR
then result =
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){M}(signA);
// Otherwise calculate numerical value and round it. else // Apply
scaling to sum-of-product let dscale : integer = if M == 32 then
UInt(fpmr.LSCALE) else UInt(fpmr.LSCALE\[3:0\]); var dp_value : real =
value1\[\[0\]\] \* value2\[\[0\]\]; for i = 1 to E-1 do dp_value =
dp_value + value1\[\[i\]\] \* value2\[\[i\]\]; end; let result_value :
real = valueA + dp_value \* (2.0^-dscale); if result_value == 0.0 then
// Sign of exact zero result is '0' for RNE rounding mode result =
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){M}('0');
else let satoflo : boolean = (fpmr.OSM == '1'); result =
[FPRound_FP8](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPRound_FP8_5){M}(result_value,
fpcr, rounding, satoflo); end; end; end; return result; end;

multiply with scaling and add to half-precision // or single-precision
matrix. // result\[2, 2\] = addend\[2, 2\] + (op1\[2, E\] \* op2\[E,
2\]) func</span>
<span id="func_FP8MatMulAddFP_7">FP8MatMulAddFP{N}(addend : bits(N), op1

<span id="shared.functions.float.fp8float.FP8Round"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/fp8float/FP8Round

<span id="shared.functions.float.fp8float.FP8Round">// FP8Round() //
========== // Used by FP8 downconvert instructions which observe
FPMR.OSC // to convert a real number OP into an FP8 value. func</span>
<span id="func_FP8Round_5">FP8Round{N}(op : real, fp8type :</span>
[FP8Type](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FP8Type),
fpcr : FPCR_Type, fpmr : FPMR_Type) =\> bits(N) begin assert N == 8;
assert fp8type IN
{[FP8Type_OFP8_E5M2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E5M2),
[FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3)};
assert op != 0.0; var result : bits(N); // Format parameters - minimum
exponent, numbers of exponent and fraction bits. let (F, minimum_exp) =
[FP8Bits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Bits_1)(fp8type);
let E : integer{} = (N - F) - 1; // Split value into sign, unrounded
mantissa and exponent. var sign : bit; var exponent : integer; var
mantissa : real; if op \< 0.0 then sign = '1'; mantissa = -op; else sign
= '0'; mantissa = op; end; (mantissa, exponent) =
[NormalizeReal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_NormalizeReal_1)(mantissa);
// When TRUE, detection of underflow occurs after rounding. let altfp :
boolean = IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_AFP) && fpcr.AH == '1'; var
biased_exp_unconstrained : integer = (exponent - minimum_exp) + 1; var
int_mant_unconstrained : integer= RoundDown(mantissa \* 2.0^F); let
error_unconstrained : real = mantissa \* 2.0^F -
Real(int_mant_unconstrained); // Start creating the exponent value for
the result. Start by biasing the actual exponent // so that the minimum
exponent becomes 1, lower values 0 (indicating possible underflow). var
biased_exp : integer = Max((exponent - minimum_exp) + 1, 0); if
biased_exp == 0 then mantissa = mantissa / 2.0^(minimum_exp - exponent);
end; // Get the unrounded mantissa as an integer, and the "units in last
place" rounding error. // \< 2.0^F if biased_exp == 0, \>= 2.0^F if not
var int_mant : integer = RoundDown(mantissa \* 2.0^F); var error : real
= mantissa \* 2.0^F - Real(int_mant); let trapped_UF : boolean =
fpcr.UFE == '1' &&
(\![InStreamingMode](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_InStreamingMode_0)()
\|\|
[IsFullA64Enabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFullA64Enabled_0)());
var round_up_unconstrained : boolean; var round_up : boolean; if altfp
then // Round to Nearest Even round_up_unconstrained =
(error_unconstrained \> 0.5 \|\| (error_unconstrained == 0.5 &&
int_mant_unconstrained\[0\] == '1')); round_up = (error \> 0.5 \|\|
(error == 0.5 && int_mant\[0\] == '1')); if round_up_unconstrained then
int_mant_unconstrained = int_mant_unconstrained + 1; if
int_mant_unconstrained == 2^(F+1) then // Rounded up to next exponent
biased_exp_unconstrained = biased_exp_unconstrained + 1;
int_mant_unconstrained = int_mant_unconstrained DIV 2; end; end; //
Follow alternate floating-point behavior of underflow after rounding if
(biased_exp_unconstrained \< 1 && int_mant_unconstrained != 0 && (error
!= 0.0 \|\| trapped_UF)) then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Underflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Underflow),
fpcr); end; else // altfp == FALSE // Underflow occurs if exponent is
too small before rounding, and result is inexact or // the Underflow
exception is trapped. This applies before rounding if FPCR.AH != '1'. if
biased_exp == 0 && (error != 0.0 \|\| trapped_UF) then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Underflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Underflow),
fpcr); end; // Round to Nearest Even round_up = (error \> 0.5 \|\|
(error == 0.5 && int_mant\[0\] == '1')); end; if round_up then int_mant
= int_mant + 1; if int_mant == 2^F then // Rounded up from denormalized
to normalized biased_exp = 1; end; if int_mant == 2^(F+1) then //
Rounded up to next exponent biased_exp = biased_exp + 1; int_mant =
int_mant DIV 2; end; end; // Deal with overflow and generate result. var
overflow : boolean; case fp8type of when
[FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3)
=\> overflow = biased_exp \>= 2^E \|\| (biased_exp == 2^E - 1 &&
int_mant == 2^(F+1) - 1); when
[FP8Type_OFP8_E5M2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E5M2)
=\> overflow = biased_exp \>= 2^E - 1; end; if overflow then result =
(if fpmr.OSC == '0' then
[FP8Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Infinity_3){N}(fp8type,
sign) else
[FP8MaxNormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8MaxNormal_3){N}(fp8type,
sign)); // Flag Overflow exception regardless of FPMR.OSC
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Overflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Overflow),
fpcr); error = 1.0; // Ensure that an Inexact exception occurs else
result = sign :: biased_exp\[E-1:0\] :: int_mant\[F-1:0\]; end; // Deal
with Inexact exception. if error != 0.0 then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Inexact](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Inexact),
fpcr); end; return result; end;

</div>

<span id="enum_FP8Type_UNSUPPORTED"></span><span id="shared.functions.float.fp8float.FP8Unpack"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/fp8float/FP8Unpack

<span id="shared.functions.float.fp8float.FP8Unpack">// FP8Unpack() //
=========== // Unpacks an FP8 value into its type, sign bit and real
number that // it represents. func</span>
<span id="func_FP8Unpack_3">FP8Unpack{N}(fpval : bits(N), fp8type
:</span>
[FP8Type](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FP8Type))
=\>
([FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType),
bit, real) begin assert N == 8; let E : integer{} = if fp8type ==
[FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3)
then 4 else 5; let F : integer{} = N - (E + 1); let sign : bit =
fpval\[N-1\]; let exp : bits(E) = fpval\[(E+F)-1:F\]; let frac : bits(F)
= fpval\[F-1:0\]; var value : real; var fptype :
[FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType);
if fp8type ==
[FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E4M3)
then if IsZero(exp) then if IsZero(frac) then fptype =
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero);
value = 0.0; else fptype =
[FPType_Denormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Denormal);
value = 2.0^-6 \* (Real(UInt(frac)) \* 2.0^-3); end; elsif IsOnes(exp)
&& IsOnes(frac) then fptype =
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN);
value = 0.0; else fptype =
[FPType_Nonzero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Nonzero);
value = 2.0^(UInt(exp)-7) \* (1.0 + Real(UInt(frac)) \* 2.0^-3); end;
elsif fp8type ==
[FP8Type_OFP8_E5M2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_OFP8_E5M2)
then if IsZero(exp) then if IsZero(frac) then fptype =
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero);
value = 0.0; else fptype =
[FPType_Denormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Denormal);
value = 2.0^-14 \* (Real(UInt(frac)) \* 2.0^-2); end; elsif IsOnes(exp)
then if IsZero(frac) then fptype =
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity);
value = 2.0^1000000; else fptype = if frac\[1\] == '1' then
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)
else
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN);
value = 0.0; end; else fptype =
[FPType_Nonzero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Nonzero);
value = 2.0^(UInt(exp)-15) \* (1.0 + Real(UInt(frac)) \* 2.0^-2); end;
else // fp8type == FP8Type_UNSUPPORTED fptype =
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN);
value = 0.0; end; if sign == '1' then value = -value; end; return
(fptype, sign, value); end;

</div>

<span id="shared.functions.float.fp8float.FPConvertFP8">//
FPConvertFP8() // ============== // Converts a half-precision or
single-precision OP to FP8 value. // The scaling factor in FPMR.NSCALE
is applied to the value before rounding. func</span>
<span id="func_FPConvertFP8_5">FPConvertFP8{M, N}(op : bits(N), fpcr_in
: FPCR_Type, fpmr : FPMR_Type) =\> bits(M) begin assert N IN {16,32} &&
M == 8; var result : bits(M); let fpexc : boolean = TRUE; var fpcr :
FPCR_Type = fpcr_in; fpcr.\[FIZ,FZ,FZ16\] = '000'; // Do not flush
denormal inputs and outputs to zero let fp8type :</span>
[FP8Type](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FP8Type)
=
[FP8DecodeType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8DecodeType_1)(fpmr.F8D);
let (fptype,sign,value) =
[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_4){N}(op,
fpcr, fpexc); if fp8type ==
[FP8Type_UNSUPPORTED](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FP8Type_UNSUPPORTED)
then result = Ones{M};
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_InvalidOp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_InvalidOp),
fpcr); elsif fptype ==
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN)
\|\| fptype ==
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)
then result =
[FP8DefaultNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8DefaultNaN_3){M}(fp8type,
fpcr); // Always generate Default NaN as result if fptype ==
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN)
then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_InvalidOp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_InvalidOp),
fpcr); end; elsif fptype ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity)
then result = (if fpmr.OSC == '0' then
[FP8Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Infinity_3){M}(fp8type,
sign) else
[FP8MaxNormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8MaxNormal_3){M}(fp8type,
sign)); elsif fptype ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero)
then result =
[FP8Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Zero_3){M}(fp8type,
sign); else let scale : integer = if N == 16 then
SInt(fpmr.NSCALE\[4:0\]) else SInt(fpmr.NSCALE); let result_value : real
= value \* (2.0^scale); result =
[FP8Round](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FP8Round_5){M}(result_value,
fp8type, fpcr, fpmr); end; return result; end;

FPCR_Type) =\> bits(N) begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; if
!</span>[UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()

<span id="func_FPAbsMax_4">FPAbsMax{N}(op1_in : bits(N), op2_in :

var done : boolean; var result : bits(N); var fpcr : FPCR_Type =
fpcr_in; fpcr.\[AH,FIZ,FZ,FZ16\] = '0000'; let op1 =
'0'::op1_in\[N-2:0\]; let op2 = '0'::op2_in\[N-2:0\]; let
(type1,-,value1) =</span>
[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_3){N}(op1,

[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_3){N}(op2,

<span id="func_FPAdd_5">FPAdd{N}(op1 : bits(N), op2 : bits(N), fpcr :

let inf2 : boolean = (type2 ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity));
let zero1 : boolean = (type1 ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));
let zero2 : boolean = (type2 ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero));

[FPDefaultNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPDefaultNaN_2){N}(fpcr);

<span id="shared.functions.float.fpconvertnan.FPConvertNaN"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/fpconvertnan/FPConvertNaN

<span id="shared.functions.float.fpconvertnan.FPConvertNaN">//
FPConvertNaN() // ============== // Converts a NaN of one floating-point
type to another func</span>
<span id="func_FPConvertNaN_3">FPConvertNaN{M, N}(op : bits(N)) =\>
bits(M) begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; assert M IN {16,32,64}; var result
: bits(M); var frac : bits(51); let sign : bit = op\[N-1\]; // Unpack
payload from input NaN case N of when 64 =\> frac = op\[50:0\]; when 32
=\> frac = op\[21:0\]::Zeros{29}; when 16 =\> frac =
op\[8:0\]::Zeros{42}; end; // Repack payload into output NaN, while //
converting an SNaN to a QNaN. case M of when 64 =\> result =
sign::Ones{M-52}::frac; when 32 =\> result =
sign::Ones{M-23}::frac\[50:29\]; when 16 =\> result =
sign::Ones{M-10}::frac\[50:42\]; end; return result; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="func_FPDefaultNaN_2">FPDefaultNaN{N}(fpcr : FPCR_Type) =\>
bits(N) begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; let E : integer{} = (if N == 16
then 5 else (if N == 32 then 8 else 11)); let F : integer{} = N - (E +
1); let sign : bit = if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_AFP) &&
!</span>[UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
then fpcr.AH else '0'; let exp : bits(E) = Ones{}; let frac : bits(F) =
'1'::Zeros{F-1}; return sign :: exp :: frac; end;

signPb = sign1_b XOR sign2_b; let infPa = inf1_a \|\| inf2_a; let infPb

[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){32}(signPa);

result_value = (value1_a \* value2_a) + (value1_b \* value2_b); if

[FPRound](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPRound_5){32}(result_value,

exceptions and in what order that they may be // accumulated before

accumulated_exceptions\[cumul\] = '1'; if ImpDefBool("Support trapping
of floating-point exceptions") then if

then

else let is_ase : boolean =

[AArch64_FPTrappedException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_FPTrappedException_2)(is_ase,
accumulated_exceptions); end; else // The exceptions generated by this
instruction are accumulated by the PE and // FPTrappedException is
called later during its execution, before the next // instruction is
executed. This field is cleared at the start of each FP instruction.
SetAccumulatedFPExceptions(accumulated_exceptions); end; elsif
[UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
then // Set the cumulative exception bit FPSCR()\[cumul\] = '1'; else //

operand, fpcr, fpexc); elsif fptype ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity)
then result =
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){N}(sign);
elsif fptype ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero)
then result =
[FPInfinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPInfinity_2){N}(sign);
if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_DivideByZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_DivideByZero),
fpcr); end; elsif ( (N == 16 && Abs(value) \< 2.0^-16) \|\| (N == 32 &&
Abs(value) \< 2.0^-128) \|\| (N == 64 && Abs(value) \< 2.0^-1024) ) then
case rounding of when
[FPRounding_TIEEVEN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_TIEEVEN)
=\> overflow_to_inf = TRUE; when
[FPRounding_POSINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_POSINF)
=\> overflow_to_inf = (sign == '0'); when
[FPRounding_NEGINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_NEGINF)
=\> overflow_to_inf = (sign == '1'); when
[FPRounding_ZERO](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_ZERO)
=\> overflow_to_inf = FALSE; end; result = if overflow_to_inf then
[FPInfinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPInfinity_2){N}(sign)
else
[FPMaxNormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPMaxNormal_2){N}(sign);
if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Overflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Overflow),
fpcr);
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Inexact](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Inexact),
fpcr); end; elsif ((fpcr.FZ == '1' && N != 16) \|\| (fpcr.FZ16 == '1' &&
N == 16)) && ( (N == 16 && Abs(value) \>= 2.0^14) \|\| (N == 32 &&
Abs(value) \>= 2.0^126) \|\| (N == 64 && Abs(value) \>= 2.0^1022) ) then
// Result flushed to zero of correct sign result =
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){N}(sign);
// Flush-to-zero never generates a trapped exception. if
[UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
then FPSCR().UFC = '1'; else if fpexc then FPSR().UFC = '1'; end; end;
else // Scale to a fixed point value in the range 0.5 \<= x \< 1.0 in
steps of 1/512, and // calculate result exponent. Scaled value has
copied sign bit, // exponent = 1022 = double-precision biased version of
-1, // fraction = original fraction var fraction : bits(52); var exp :
integer; case N of when 16 =\> fraction = operand\[9:0\] :: Zeros{42};
exp = UInt(operand\[14:10\]); when 32 =\> fraction = operand\[22:0\] ::
Zeros{29}; exp = UInt(operand\[30:23\]); when 64 =\> fraction =
operand\[51:0\]; exp = UInt(operand\[62:52\]); end; if exp == 0 then if
fraction\[51\] == '0' then exp = -1; fraction = fraction\[49:0\]::'00';
else fraction = fraction\[50:0\]::'0'; end; end; var scaled : integer;
let increasedprecision : boolean = N==32 &&
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RPRES) && altfp; if !increasedprecision then
scaled = UInt('1'::fraction\[51:44\]); else scaled =
UInt('1'::fraction\[51:41\]); end; var result_exp : integer; case N of
when 16 =\> result_exp = 29 - exp; // In range 29-30 = -1 to 29+1 = 30
when 32 =\> result_exp = 253 - exp; // In range 253-254 = -1 to 253+1 =
254 when 64 =\> result_exp = 2045 - exp; // In range 2045-2046 = -1 to
2045+1 = 2046 end; // Scaled is in range 256 .. 511 or 2048 .. 4095
range representing a // fixed-point number in range \[0.5 .. 1.0\]. let
estimate : integer =
[RecipEstimate](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_RecipEstimate_2)(scaled,
increasedprecision); // Estimate is in the range 256 .. 511 or 4096 ..
8191 representing a // fixed-point result in the range \[1.0 .. 2.0\].
// Convert to scaled floating point result with copied sign bit, //
high-order bits from estimate, and exponent calculated above. if
!increasedprecision then fraction = estimate\[7:0\] :: Zeros{44}; else
fraction = estimate\[11:0\] :: Zeros{40}; end; if result_exp == 0 then
fraction = '1' :: fraction\[51:1\]; elsif result_exp == -1 then fraction
= '01' :: fraction\[51:2\]; result_exp = 0; end; case N of when 16 =\>
result = sign :: result_exp\[N-12:0\] :: fraction\[51:42\]; when 32 =\>
result = sign :: result_exp\[N-25:0\] :: fraction\[51:29\]; when 64 =\>
result = sign :: result_exp\[N-54:0\] :: fraction\[51:0\]; end; end;
return result; end;

<span id="shared.functions.float.fprecipestimate.RecipEstimate"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/fprecipestimate/RecipEstimate

<span id="shared.functions.float.fprecipestimate.RecipEstimate">//
RecipEstimate() // =============== // Compute estimate of reciprocal of
9-bit fixed-point number. // // a is in range 256 .. 511 or 2048 .. 4096
representing a number in // the range 0.5 \<= x \< 1.0. //
increasedprecision determines if the mantissa is 8-bit or 12-bit. //
result is in the range 256 .. 511 or 4096 .. 8191 representing a //
number in the range 1.0 to 511/256 or 1.00 to 8191/4096. func</span>
<span id="func_RecipEstimate_2">RecipEstimate(a_in : integer,
increasedprecision : boolean) =\> integer begin var a : integer = a_in;
var r : integer; if !increasedprecision then assert 256 \<= a && a \<
512; a = a\*2+1; // Round to nearest let b : integer = (2 ^ 19) DIVRM a;
r = (b+1) DIVRM 2; // Round to nearest assert 256 \<= r && r \< 512;
else assert 2048 \<= a && a \< 4096; a = a\*2+1; // Round to nearest let
b : integer = (2 ^ 26) DIVRM a; r = (b+1) DIVRM 2; // Round to nearest
assert 4096 \<= r && r \< 8192; end; return r; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="shared.functions.float.fprecpx.FPRecpX">// FPRecpX() //
========= func</span> <span id="func_FPRecpX_3">FPRecpX{N}(op : bits(N),
fpcr_in : FPCR_Type) =\> bits(N) begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; var fpcr
: FPCR_Type = fpcr_in; let isbfloat16 : boolean = FALSE; let (F, -)
=</span>
[FPBits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPBits_2)(N,
isbfloat16); let E = (N - F) - 1; var result : bits(N); var exp :
bits(E); var max_exp : bits(E); let frac : bits(F) = Zeros{}; let altfp
: boolean = IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_AFP) && fpcr.AH == '1'; let fpexc
: boolean = !altfp; // Generate no floating-point exceptions if altfp
then fpcr.\[FIZ,FZ\] = '11'; end; // Flush denormal input and output to
zero let (fptype,sign,value) =
[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_4){N}(op,
fpcr, fpexc); exp = op\[F+:E\]; max_exp = Ones{E} - 1; if fptype ==
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN)
\|\| fptype ==
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)
then result =
[FPProcessNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessNaN_5){N}(fptype,
op, fpcr, fpexc); else if IsZero(exp) then // Zero and denormals result
= ZeroExtend{N}(sign::max_exp::frac); else // Infinities and normals
result = ZeroExtend{N}(sign::NOT(exp)::frac); end; end; return result;
end;

fpcr, rounding, isbfloat16, fpexc); end; // FPRoundBase() //
============= // For FP8 multiply-accumulate, dot product, and outer

[FPRounding](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPRounding),

boolean = FALSE; return
[FPRoundBase](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPRoundBase_7){N}(op,
fpcr, rounding, isbfloat16, fpexc, satoflo); end; // FPRoundBase() //
============= // Convert a real number 'op' into an N-bit floating-point
value using the // supplied rounding mode 'rounding'. // // The 'fpcr'
argument supplies FPCR control bits and 'fpexc' controls the //
generation of floating-point exceptions. Status information is updated

controls whether overflow generates Infinity or MaxNorm for 8-bit
floating-point // data processing instructions. func
<span id="func_FPRoundBase_7">FPRoundBase{N}(op : real, fpcr :
FPCR_Type, rounding :</span>
[FPRounding](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPRounding),
isbfloat16 : boolean, fpexc : boolean, satoflo : boolean) =\> bits(N)
begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; assert op != 0.0; assert rounding !=
[FPRounding_TIEAWAY](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_TIEAWAY);
var result : bits(N); // Obtain format parameters - minimum exponent,
numbers of exponent and fraction bits. let (F, minimum_exp) =
[FPBits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPBits_2)(N,
isbfloat16); let zeros = if N == 32 && isbfloat16 then 16 else 0; let E
= N - (F + 1 + zeros); // Split value into sign, unrounded mantissa and

= op; end; (mantissa, exponent) =
[NormalizeReal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_NormalizeReal_1)(mantissa);
// When TRUE, detection of underflow occurs after rounding and the test
for a // denormalized number for single and double precision values
occurs after rounding. let altfp : boolean =
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_AFP) &&
\![UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
&& fpcr.AH == '1'; // Deal with flush-to-zero before rounding if FPCR.AH
!= '1'. if (!altfp && ((fpcr.FZ == '1' && N != 16) \|\| (fpcr.FZ16 ==
'1' && N == 16)) && exponent \< minimum_exp) then // Flush-to-zero never
generates a trapped exception. if
[UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
then FPSCR().UFC = '1'; else if fpexc then FPSR().UFC = '1'; end; end;

[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){N}(sign);

1; var int_mant_unconstrained : integer = RoundDown(mantissa \* 2.0^F);

(\![InStreamingMode](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_InStreamingMode_0)()
\|\|
[IsFullA64Enabled](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFullA64Enabled_0)());
if !altfp && biased_exp == 0 && (error != 0.0 \|\| trapped_UF) then if
fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Underflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Underflow),
fpcr); end; end; // Round result according to rounding mode. var
round_up_unconstrained : boolean; var round_up : boolean; var
overflow_to_inf : boolean; if altfp then case rounding of when
[FPRounding_TIEEVEN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_TIEEVEN)
=\> round_up_unconstrained = (error_unconstrained \> 0.5 \|\|
(error_unconstrained == 0.5 && int_mant_unconstrained\[0\] == '1'));
round_up = (error \> 0.5 \|\| (error == 0.5 && int_mant\[0\] == '1'));
overflow_to_inf = !satoflo; when
[FPRounding_POSINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_POSINF)
=\> round_up_unconstrained = (error_unconstrained != 0.0 && sign ==
'0'); round_up = (error != 0.0 && sign == '0'); overflow_to_inf = (sign
== '0'); when
[FPRounding_NEGINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_NEGINF)
=\> round_up_unconstrained = (error_unconstrained != 0.0 && sign ==
'1'); round_up = (error != 0.0 && sign == '1'); overflow_to_inf = (sign
== '1'); when
[FPRounding_ZERO](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_ZERO),
[FPRounding_ODD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_ODD)
=\> round_up_unconstrained = FALSE; round_up = FALSE; overflow_to_inf =
FALSE; end; if round_up_unconstrained then int_mant_unconstrained =
int_mant_unconstrained + 1; if int_mant_unconstrained == 2^(F+1) then //
Rounded up to next exponent biased_exp_unconstrained =
biased_exp_unconstrained + 1; int_mant_unconstrained =
int_mant_unconstrained DIV 2; end; end; // Deal with flush-to-zero and
underflow after rounding if FPCR.AH == '1'. if biased_exp_unconstrained
\< 1 && int_mant_unconstrained != 0 then // the result of unconstrained
rounding is less than the minimum normalized number if (fpcr.FZ == '1'

fpexc then FPSR().UFC = '1';
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Inexact](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Inexact),
fpcr); end; return
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){N}(sign);
elsif error != 0.0 \|\| trapped_UF then if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Underflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Underflow),
fpcr); end; end; end; else // altfp == FALSE case rounding of when
[FPRounding_TIEEVEN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_TIEEVEN)
=\> round_up = (error \> 0.5 \|\| (error == 0.5 && int_mant\[0\] ==
'1')); overflow_to_inf = !satoflo; when
[FPRounding_POSINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_POSINF)
=\> round_up = (error != 0.0 && sign == '0'); overflow_to_inf = (sign ==
'0'); when
[FPRounding_NEGINF](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_NEGINF)
=\> round_up = (error != 0.0 && sign == '1'); overflow_to_inf = (sign ==
'1'); when
[FPRounding_ZERO](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_ZERO),
[FPRounding_ODD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_ODD)

then int_mant = int_mant + 1; if int_mant == 2^F then // Rounded up from
denormalized to normalized biased_exp = 1; end; if int_mant == 2^(F+1)
then // Rounded up to next exponent biased_exp = biased_exp + 1;
int_mant = int_mant DIV 2; end; end; // Handle rounding to odd if error
!= 0.0 && rounding ==
[FPRounding_ODD](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPRounding_ODD)
&& int_mant\[0\] == '0' then int_mant = int_mant + 1; end; // Deal with
overflow and generate result. if N != 16 \|\| fpcr.AHP == '0' then //

result = if overflow_to_inf then
[FPInfinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPInfinity_2){N}(sign)
else
[FPMaxNormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPMaxNormal_2){N}(sign);
if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Overflow](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Overflow),
fpcr); end; error = 1.0; // Ensure that an Inexact exception occurs else
result = sign :: biased_exp\[E-1:0\] :: int_mant\[F-1:0\] ::
Zeros{N-(E+F+1)}; end; else // Alternative half precision if biased_exp

fpcr); end; error = 0.0; // Ensure that an Inexact exception does not
occur else result = sign :: biased_exp\[E-1:0\] :: int_mant\[F-1:0\] ::
Zeros{N-(E+F+1)}; end; end; // Deal with Inexact exception. if error !=
0.0 then if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_Inexact](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_Inexact),
fpcr); end; end; return result; end;

<span id="shared.functions.float.fpround.FPRoundCV">// FPRoundCV() //

<span id="func_FPRoundCV_4">FPRoundCV{N}(op : real, fpcr_in : FPCR_Type,

<span id="shared.functions.float.fprsqrtestimate.FPRSqrtEstimate">//
FPRSqrtEstimate() // ================= func</span>
<span id="func_FPRSqrtEstimate_3">FPRSqrtEstimate{N}(operand : bits(N),
fpcr_in : FPCR_Type) =\> bits(N) begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; var fpcr
: FPCR_Type = fpcr_in; // When using alternative floating-point
behavior, do not generate // floating-point exceptions and flush
denormal input to zero. let altfp : boolean =
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_AFP) &&
!</span>[UsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_UsingAArch32_0)()
&& fpcr.AH == '1'; let fpexc : boolean = !altfp; if altfp then
fpcr.\[FIZ,FZ\] = '11'; end; let (fptype,sign,value) :
([FPType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FPType),
bit, real) =
[FPUnpack](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPUnpack_4){N}(operand,
fpcr, fpexc); var result : bits(N); if fptype ==
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN)
\|\| fptype ==
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)
then result =
[FPProcessNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessNaN_5){N}(fptype,
operand, fpcr, fpexc); elsif fptype ==
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero)
then result =
[FPInfinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPInfinity_2){N}(sign);
if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_DivideByZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_DivideByZero),
fpcr); end; elsif sign == '1' then result =
[FPDefaultNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPDefaultNaN_2){N}(fpcr);
if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_InvalidOp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_InvalidOp),
fpcr); end; elsif fptype ==
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity)
then result =
[FPZero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPZero_2){N}('0');
else // Scale to a fixed-point value in the range 0.25 \<= x \< 1.0 in
steps of 512, with the // evenness or oddness of the exponent unchanged,
and calculate result exponent. // Scaled value has copied sign bit,
exponent = 1022 or 1021 = double-precision // biased version of -1 or
-2, fraction = original fraction extended with zeros. var fraction :
bits(52); var exp : integer; case N of when 16 =\> fraction =
operand\[9:0\] :: Zeros{42}; exp = UInt(operand\[14:10\]); when 32 =\>
fraction = operand\[22:0\] :: Zeros{29}; exp = UInt(operand\[30:23\]);
when 64 =\> fraction = operand\[51:0\]; exp = UInt(operand\[62:52\]);
end; if exp == 0 then while fraction\[51\] == '0' looplimit 51 do
fraction = fraction\[50:0\] :: '0'; exp = exp - 1; end; fraction =
fraction\[50:0\] :: '0'; end; var scaled : integer; let
increasedprecision : boolean = N==32 && IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RPRES)

UInt('01'::fraction\[51:45\]); end; else if exp\[0\] == '0' then scaled
= UInt('1'::fraction\[51:41\]); else scaled =
UInt('01'::fraction\[51:42\]); end; end; var result_exp : integer; case
N of when 16 =\> result_exp = ( 44 - exp) DIVRM 2; when 32 =\>
result_exp = ( 380 - exp) DIVRM 2; when 64 =\> result_exp = (3068 - exp)
DIVRM 2; end; let estimate : integer =
[RecipSqrtEstimate](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_RecipSqrtEstimate_2)(scaled,
increasedprecision); // Estimate is in the range 256 .. 511 or 4096 ..
8191 representing a // fixed-point result in the range \[1.0 .. 2.0\].
// Convert to scaled floating point result with copied sign bit and
high-order // fraction bits, and exponent calculated above. case N of
when 16 =\> result = '0' :: result_exp\[N-12:0\] ::
estimate\[7:0\]::Zeros{2}; when 32 =\> if !increasedprecision then
result = '0' :: result_exp\[N-25:0\] :: estimate\[7:0\]::Zeros{15}; else
result = '0' :: result_exp\[N-25:0\] :: estimate\[11:0\]::Zeros{11};
end; when 64 =\> result = '0' :: result_exp\[N-54:0\] ::
estimate\[7:0\]::Zeros{44}; end; end; return result; end;

<span id="shared.functions.float.fprsqrtestimate.RecipSqrtEstimate"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/float/fprsqrtestimate/RecipSqrtEstimate

<span id="shared.functions.float.fprsqrtestimate.RecipSqrtEstimate">//
RecipSqrtEstimate() // =================== // Compute estimate of
reciprocal square root of 9-bit fixed-point number. // // a_in is in
range 128 .. 511 or 1024 .. 4095, with increased precision, //
representing a number in the range 0.25 \<= x \< 1.0. //
increasedprecision determines if the mantissa is 8-bit or 12-bit. //
result is in the range 256 .. 511 or 4096 .. 8191, with increased
precision, // representing a number in the range 1.0 to 511/256 or
8191/4096. func</span>
<span id="func_RecipSqrtEstimate_2">RecipSqrtEstimate(a_in : integer,
increasedprecision : boolean) =\> integer begin var a : integer = a_in;
var r : integer; if !increasedprecision then assert 128 \<= a && a \<
512; if a \< 256 then // a in \[128, 255\], represents a value in
\[0.25, 0.5) a = a\*2+1; // promote to 9-bit range in units of 1/512
else // a in \[256, 511\], represents a value in \[0.5, 1.0) a = (a
\>\> 1) \<\< 1; // Discard bottom bit a = (a+1)\*2; // round up to
nearest 1/256 and convert end; var b : integer = 512; while
a\*(b+1)\*(b+1) \< 2^28 looplimit 510 do b = b+1; end; // b = largest b
such that b \< 2^14 / sqrt(a) r = (b+1) DIVRM 2; // Round to nearest
assert 256 \<= r && r \< 512; else assert 1024 \<= a && a \< 4096; if a
\< 2048 then // a in \[1024, 2047\], represents a value in \[0.25, 0.5)
a = a\*2 + 1; // promote to 13-bit range in units of 1/8192 else // a in
\[2048, 4095\], represents a value in \[0.5, 1.0) a = (a \>\> 1) \<\< 1;
// Discard bottom bit a = (a+1)\*2; // round up to nearest 1/4096 and
convert end; var b : integer = 8192; while a\*(b+1)\*(b+1) \< 2^39
looplimit (2^39 - (2049 \* 8193^2)) do b = b+1; end; r = (b+1) DIVRM 2;
// Round to nearest assert 4096 \<= r && r \< 8192; end; return r;
end;</span>

</div>

value = 2.0^(UInt(exp32)-127) \* (1.0 + Real(UInt(frac32)) \* 2.0^-23);
end; else // N == 64 sign = fpval\[63\]; let exp64 : bits(11) =
fpval\[62:52\]; let frac64 : bits(52) = fpval\[51:0\]; if IsZero(exp64)
then if IsZero(frac64) then // Produce zero if value is zero. fptype =
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero);
value = 0.0; elsif fz \|\| fiz then // Flush-to-zero if FIZ==1 or
AH,FZ==01 fptype =
[FPType_Zero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Zero);
value = 0.0; // Check whether to raise Input Denormal floating-point
exception. // fpcr.FIZ==1 does not raise Input Denormal exception. if fz
then // Denormalized input flushed to zero if fpexc then
[FPProcessException](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_FPProcessException_2)([FPExc_InputDenorm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPExc_InputDenorm),
fpcr); end; end; else fptype =
[FPType_Denormal](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Denormal);
value = 2.0^-1022 \* (Real(UInt(frac64)) \* 2.0^-52); end; elsif
IsOnes(exp64) then if IsZero(frac64) then fptype =
[FPType_Infinity](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Infinity);
value = 2.0^1000000; else fptype = if frac64\[51\] == '1' then
[FPType_QNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_QNaN)
else
[FPType_SNaN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_SNaN);
value = 0.0; end; else fptype =
[FPType_Nonzero](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_FPType_Nonzero);
value = 2.0^(UInt(exp64)-1023) \* (1.0 + Real(UInt(frac64)) \* 2.0^-52);
end; end; if sign == '1' then value = -value; end; return (fptype, sign,
value); end;

</div>

begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; let E : integer{} = (if N == 16 then 5
else (if N == 32 then 8 else 11)); let F : integer{} = N - (E + 1); let

<span id="func_VFPExpandImm_2">VFPExpandImm{N}(imm8 : bits(8)) =\>
bits(N) begin assert N IN {16,32,64}; let E : integer{} = (if N == 16
then 5 else (if N == 32 then 8 else 11)); let F : integer{} = (N - E) -
1; let sign : bit = imm8\[7\]; let exp : bits(E) =
NOT(imm8\[6\])::Replicate{E - 3}(imm8\[6\])::imm8\[5:4\]; let frac :

:: exp :: frac; return result; end;</span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/integer/AddWithCarry

<span id="shared.functions.integer.AddWithCarry">// AddWithCarry() //
============== // Integer addition with carry input, returning result
and NZCV flags func</span>
<span id="func_AddWithCarry_4">AddWithCarry{N}(x : bits(N), y : bits(N),
carry_in : bit) =\> (bits(N), bits(4)) begin let unsigned_sum : integer
= UInt(x) + UInt(y) + UInt(carry_in); let signed_sum : integer =
SInt(x) + SInt(y) + UInt(carry_in); let result : bits(N) =
unsigned_sum\[N-1:0\]; // same value as signed_sum\[N-1:0\] let n : bit
= result\[N-1\]; let z : bit = if IsZero(result) then '1' else '0'; let
c : bit = if UInt(result) == unsigned_sum then '0' else '1'; let v : bit
= if SInt(result) == signed_sum then '0' else '1'; return (result,
n::z::c::v); end;</span>

</div>

<span id="shared.functions.memory.EffectiveMTX">// EffectiveMTX() //
============== // Returns the effective MTX in the AArch64 stage 1
translation regime for "el". func</span>
<span id="func_EffectiveMTX_3">EffectiveMTX(address : bits(64), is_instr
: boolean, el : bits(2)) =\> bit begin var mtx : bit; assert</span>
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)(el);
let regime : bits(2) =
[S1TranslationRegime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_S1TranslationRegime_1)(el);
assert(\![ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)(regime));
if is_instr then mtx = '0'; else case regime of when
[EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1)
=\> mtx = if address\[55\] == '1' then TCR_EL1().MTX1 else
TCR_EL1().MTX0; when
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)
=\> if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_VHE) &&
[ELIsInHost](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELIsInHost_1)(el)
then mtx = if address\[55\] == '1' then TCR_EL2().MTX1 else
TCR_EL2().MTX0; else mtx = TCR_EL2().MTX; end; when
[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3)
=\> mtx = TCR_EL3().MTX; end; end; return mtx; end;

</div>

then tbi = if address\[55\] == '1' then TCR_EL2().TBI1 else
TCR_EL2().TBI0; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAuth) then tbid = if
address\[55\] == '1' then TCR_EL2().TBID1 else TCR_EL2().TBID0; end;
else tbi = TCR_EL2().TBI; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAuth) then tbid
= TCR_EL2().TBID; end; end; when
[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3)
=\> tbi = TCR_EL3().TBI; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAuth) then tbid =
TCR_EL3().TBID; end; end; return (if (tbi == '1' &&
(!IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAuth) \|\| tbid == '0' \|\| !IsInstr)) then
'1' else '0'); end;

</div>

<div class="ps">

<span id="shared.functions.memory.EffectiveTCMA"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/memory/EffectiveTCMA

<span id="shared.functions.memory.EffectiveTCMA">// EffectiveTCMA() //
=============== // Returns the effective TCMA of a virtual address in
the stage 1 translation regime for "el". func</span>
<span id="func_EffectiveTCMA_2">EffectiveTCMA(address : bits(64), el :
bits(2)) =\> bit begin var tcma : bit; assert</span>
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)(el);
let regime : bits(2) =
[S1TranslationRegime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_S1TranslationRegime_1)(el);
assert(\![ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)(regime));
case regime of when
[EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1)
=\> tcma = if address\[55\] == '1' then TCR_EL1().TCMA1 else
TCR_EL1().TCMA0; when
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)
=\> if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_VHE) &&
[ELIsInHost](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELIsInHost_1)(el)
then tcma = if address\[55\] == '1' then TCR_EL2().TCMA1 else
TCR_EL2().TCMA0; else tcma = TCR_EL2().TCMA; end; when
[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3)
=\> tcma = TCR_EL3().TCMA; end; return tcma; end;

</div>

<span id="shared.functions.memory.Hint_Prefetch"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/memory/Hint_Prefetch

<span id="shared.functions.memory.Hint_Prefetch">// Hint_Prefetch() //
=============== // Signals the memory system that memory accesses of
type HINT to or from the specified address are // likely in the near
future. The memory system may take some action to speed up the memory //
accesses when they do occur, such as pre-loading the specified address
into one or more // caches as indicated by the innermost cache level
target (0=L1, 1=L2, etc) and non-temporal hint // stream. Any or all
prefetch hints may be treated as a NOP. A prefetch hint must not cause a
// synchronous abort due to Alignment or Translation faults and the
like. Its only effect on // software-visible state should be on caches
and TLBs associated with address, which must be // accessible by reads,
writes or execution, as defined in the translation regime of the current
// Exception level. It is guaranteed not to access Device memory. // A
Prefetch_EXEC hint must not result in an access that could not be
performed by a speculative // instruction fetch, therefore if all
associated MMUs are disabled, then it cannot access any // memory
location that cannot be accessed by instruction fetches. impdef func
Hint_Prefetch(address : bits(64), hint :</span>
[PrefetchHint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PrefetchHint),
target : integer, stream : boolean) begin return; end;

</div>

<div class="ps">

<span id="shared.functions.memory.Hint_RangePrefetch"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/memory/Hint_RangePrefetch

// Hint_RangePrefetch() // ==================== // Signals the memory
system that data memory accesses from a specified range // of addresses
are likely to occur in the near future. The memory system can // respond
by taking actions that are expected to speed up the memory accesses //
when they do occur, such as preloading the locations within the
specified // address ranges into one or more caches. impdef func
Hint_RangePrefetch(address : bits(64), length : integer, stride :
integer, count : integer, reuse : integer, operation : bits(6)) begin
return; end;

</div>

<span id="shared.functions.memory.Hint_RangePrefetch"></span>

<span id="shared.functions.mpam.MAP_vPARTID">// MAP_vPARTID() //
============= // Performs conversion of virtual PARTID into physical

choices for the conversion. func</span>
<span id="func_MAP_vPARTID_1">MAP_vPARTID(vpartid :</span>
[PARTIDType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PARTIDType))
=\>
([PARTIDType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PARTIDType),
boolean) begin // should not ever be called if EL2 is not implemented //
or is implemented but not enabled in the current // security state. var
ret :
[PARTIDType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PARTIDType);
var err : boolean; var virt : integer = UInt(vpartid); let vpmrmax :
integer = UInt(MPAMIDR_EL1().VPMR_MAX); // vpartid_max is largest
vpartid supported let vpartid_max : integer = (vpmrmax \<\< 2) + 3; //
One of many ways to reduce vpartid to value less than vpartid_max. if
UInt(vpartid) \> vpartid_max then virt = virt MOD (vpartid_max+1); end;
// Check for valid mapping entry. if MPAMVPMV_EL2()\[virt\] == '1' then
// vpartid has a valid mapping, access the map. ret =
[mapvpmw](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_mapvpmw_1)(virt);

MPAMVPMV_EL2()\[0\] == '1' then // Use default mapping for vpartid == 0.
ret = MPAMVPM0_EL2()\[0 +: 16\]; err = FALSE; // Neither is valid, use
default physical PARTID. else ret =
[DEFAULT_PARTID](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_DEFAULT_PARTID);
err = TRUE; end; // Check that the physical PARTID is in-range. // This
physical PARTID came from a virtual mapping entry. let partid_max :
integer = UInt(MPAMIDR_EL1().PARTID_MAX); if UInt(ret) \> partid_max
then // Out of range, so return default physical PARTID ret =
[DEFAULT_PARTID](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_DEFAULT_PARTID);
err = TRUE; end; return (ret, err); end;

<span id="shared.functions.mpam.mapvpmw">// mapvpmw() // ========= //
Map a virtual PARTID into a physical PARTID using // the MPAMVPMn_EL2
registers. // vpartid is now assumed in-range and valid (checked by
caller) // returns physical PARTID from mapping entry. func</span>
<span id="func_mapvpmw_1">mapvpmw(vpartid : integer) =\></span>
[PARTIDType](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PARTIDType)
begin var vpmw : bits(64); let wd : integer = vpartid DIVRM 4; case wd
of when 0 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM0_EL2(); when 1 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM1_EL2();
when 2 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM2_EL2(); when 3 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM3_EL2(); when
4 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM4_EL2(); when 5 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM5_EL2(); when 6
=\> vpmw = MPAMVPM6_EL2(); when 7 =\> vpmw = MPAMVPM7_EL2(); otherwise
=\> vpmw = Zeros{64}; end; // vpme_lsb selects LSB of field within
register let vpme_lsb : integer = (vpartid MOD 4) \* 16; return
vpmw\[vpme_lsb +: 16\]; end;

\[v8.5\] PACM : bits (1), // PAC instruction modifier ZA : bits (1), //

IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_PAN) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PAN
= spsr\[22\]; end; if
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).nRW
== '1' then // AArch32 state
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).Q
= spsr\[27\];
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).IT
=
[RestoredITBits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_RestoredITBits_2){N}(spsr);
[ShouldAdvanceIT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_ShouldAdvanceIT)
= FALSE; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_DIT) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).DIT
= (if
([Restarting](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_Restarting_0)()
\|\| from_aarch64) then spsr\[24\] else spsr\[21\]); end;
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).GE
= spsr\[19:16\];
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).E
= spsr\[9\]; PSTATE.\[A,I,F\] = spsr\[8:6\]; // No PSTATE.D in AArch32
state
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).T
= spsr\[5\]; // PSTATE.J is RES0 else // AArch64 state if
(IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_EBEP) \|\| IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SPE_EXC)
\|\| IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_TRBE_EXC)) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).PM
= spsr\[32\]; end; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_NMI) then
[PSTATE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_PSTATE).ALLINT
= spsr\[13\]; end; PSTATE.\[D,A,I,F\] = spsr\[9:6\]; // No
PSTATE.\[Q,IT,GE,E,T\] in AArch64 state end; return; end;

<span id="shared.functions.system.WaitForEvent">// WaitForEvent() //

then return; end; if

then EnterLowPowerState(); end; return; end; // WaitForEvent() //
============== // PE optionally suspends execution until one of the
following occurs: // - A WFE wakeup event. // - A reset. // - The
implementation chooses to resume execution. // - A Wait for Event with
Timeout (WFET) is executing, and a local timeout event occurs // It is
IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether restarting execution after the period of
// suspension causes the Event Register to be cleared. func
<span id="func_WaitForEvent_1">WaitForEvent(localtimeout : integer)
begin if</span>
[Halted](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_Halted_0)()
then return; end; if
!([IsEventRegisterSet](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsEventRegisterSet_0)()
\|\|
[LocalTimeoutEvent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_LocalTimeoutEvent_1)(localtimeout))
then EnterLowPowerState(); end; return; end;

if</span>

<span id="shared.functions.system.WatchpointRelatedSyndrome"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/system/WatchpointRelatedSyndrome

<span id="shared.functions.system.WatchpointRelatedSyndrome">//
WatchpointRelatedSyndrome() // =========================== // Update
common Watchpoint related fields. func</span>
<span id="func_WatchpointRelatedSyndrome_1">WatchpointRelatedSyndrome(fault
:</span>
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord))
=\> bits(24) begin var syndrome : bits(24) = Zeros{}; if
fault.watchptinfo.maybe_false_match then syndrome\[16\] = '1'; // WPF
elsif IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_Debugv8p2) then syndrome\[16\] =
ImpDefBit("WPF value on TRUE Watchpoint match"); end; if
[IsRelaxedWatchpointAccess](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsRelaxedWatchpointAccess_1)(fault.accessdesc)
then if
[HaltOnBreakpointOrWatchpoint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaltOnBreakpointOrWatchpoint_0)()
then if ImpDefBool("EDWAR is not valid on watchpoint debug event") then
syndrome\[10\] = '1'; // FnV end; else if ImpDefBool("FAR is not valid
on watchpoint exception") then syndrome\[10\] = '1'; // FnV end; end;
else if
[WatchpointFARNotPrecise](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_WatchpointFARNotPrecise_1)(fault)
then syndrome\[15\] = '1'; // FnP end; end; // Watchpoint number is
valid if FEAT_Debugv8p9 is implemented or // if Feat_Debugv8p2 is
implemented and below set of conditions are satisfied: // - Either FnV =
1 or FnP = 1. // - If the address recorded in FAR is not within a
naturally-aligned block of memory. // Otherwise, it is IMPLEMENTATION
DEFINED if watchpoint number is valid. if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_Debugv8p9) then syndrome\[17\] = '1'; // WPTV
syndrome\[23:18\] = fault.watchptinfo.watchpt_num\[5:0\]; // WPT elsif
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_Debugv8p2) then if syndrome\[15\] == '1' \|\|
syndrome\[10\] == '1' then // Either of FnP or FnV is 1 syndrome\[17\] =
'1'; // WPTV elsif
\![AddressInNaturallyAlignedBlock](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AddressInNaturallyAlignedBlock_2)(fault.vaddress,
fault.watchptinfo.vaddress) then syndrome\[17\] = '1'; // WPTV elsif
ImpDefBool("WPTV field is valid") then syndrome\[17\] = '1'; end; if
syndrome\[17\] == '1' then syndrome\[23:18\] =
fault.watchptinfo.watchpt_num\[5:0\]; // WPT else syndrome\[23:18\] =
ARBITRARY : bits(6); end; end; return syndrome; end;

</div>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/tlbi/TLBIRecord

<span id="shared.functions.tlbi.TLBIRecord">// TLBIRecord // ==========
// Details related to a TLBI operation. type</span>
<span id="type_TLBIRecord">TLBIRecord of record { op :</span>
[TLBIOp](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TLBIOp),
from_aarch64 : boolean, // originated as an AArch64 operation security :
[SecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SecurityState),
regime :
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime),
use_vmid : boolean, vmid : bits(NUM_VMIDBITS), asid :
bits(NUM_ASIDBITS), level :
[TLBILevel](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TLBILevel),
attr :
[TLBIMemAttr](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TLBIMemAttr),
ipaspace :
[PASpace](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PASpace),
// For operations that take IPA as input address address : bits(64), //
input address, for range operations, start address end_address :
bits(64), // for range operations, end; address d64 : boolean, // For
operations that evict VMSAv8-64 based TLB entries d128 : boolean, // For
operations that evict VMSAv9-128 based TLB entries ttl : bits(4), //
translation table walk level holding the leaf entry // for the address
being invalidated // For Non-Range Invalidations: // When the ttl is //
'00xx' : this applies to all TLB entries // Otherwise : TLBIP
instructions invalidates D128 TLB // entries only // TLBI instructions
invalidates D64 TLB // entries only // For Range Invalidations: // When
the ttl is // '00' : this applies to all TLB entries // Otherwise :
TLBIP instructions invalidates D128 TLB // entries only // TLBI
instructions invalidates D64 TLB // entries only tg : bits(2) // for
range operations, translation granule };
