<span id="shared.functions.unpredictable.ConstrainUnpredictableBits"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/unpredictable/ConstrainUnpredictableBits

<span id="shared.functions.unpredictable.ConstrainUnpredictableBits">//
ConstrainUnpredictableBits() // ============================ // This is
a variant of ConstrainUnpredictable for when the result can be
Constraint_UNKNOWN. // If the result is Constraint_UNKNOWN then the
function also returns UNKNOWN value, but that // value is always an
allocated value; that is, one for which the behavior is not itself //
CONSTRAINED. readonly impdef func</span>
<span id="func_ConstrainUnpredictableBits_0">ConstrainUnpredictableBits{width}(which
:</span>
[Unpredictable](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Unpredictable)
) =\>
([Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint),
bits(width)) begin let c :
[Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint)
= ConstrainUnpredictable(which); case c of when
[Constraint_UNKNOWN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_UNKNOWN)
=\> return (c, Zeros{width}); // See notes; this is an example
implementation only when
[Constraint_PMSCR_PCT_VIRT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_PMSCR_PCT_VIRT)
=\> return (c, Zeros{width}); when
[Constraint_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_NC)
where which ==
[Unpredictable_S2RESMEMATTR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_S2RESMEMATTR)
=\> assert width == 4; return (c, ZeroExtend{width}('0101')); when
[Constraint_WT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_WT)
where which ==
[Unpredictable_S2RESMEMATTR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_S2RESMEMATTR)
=\> assert width == 4; return (c, ZeroExtend{width}('1010')); when
[Constraint_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_WB)
where which ==
[Unpredictable_S2RESMEMATTR](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_S2RESMEMATTR)
=\> assert width == 4; return (c, ZeroExtend{width}('1111')); when
[Constraint_EL1TIMESTAMP](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_EL1TIMESTAMP)
=\> return (c, ZeroExtend{width}('01')); when
[Constraint_EL2TIMESTAMP](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_EL2TIMESTAMP)
=\> return (c, ZeroExtend{width}('01')); when
[Constraint_MAPTOALLOCATED](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_MAPTOALLOCATED)
=\> return (c, ZeroExtend{width}('010')); // return non-secure
state_bits otherwise =\> return (c, ARBITRARY : bits(width)); // bits
result not used end; end;

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/unpredictable/ConstrainUnpredictableInteger

<span id="shared.functions.unpredictable.ConstrainUnpredictableInteger">//
ConstrainUnpredictableInteger() // =============================== //
This is a variant of ConstrainUnpredictable for when the result can be
Constraint_UNKNOWN. // If the result is Constraint_UNKNOWN then the
function also returns an UNKNOWN // value in the range low to high,
inclusive. impdef func</span>
<span id="func_ConstrainUnpredictableInteger_3">ConstrainUnpredictableInteger(low
: integer, high : integer, which :</span>
[Unpredictable](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Unpredictable))
=\>
([Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint),integer)
begin let c :
[Constraint](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Constraint)
= ConstrainUnpredictable(which); if c ==
[Constraint_UNKNOWN](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Constraint_UNKNOWN)
then return (c, low); // See notes; this is an example implementation
only else return (c, ARBITRARY : integer); // integer result not used
end; end;

</div>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/unpredictable/ConstrainUnpredictableProcedure

<span id="shared.functions.unpredictable.ConstrainUnpredictableProcedure">//
ConstrainUnpredictableProcedure() // =================================
// This is a variant of ConstrainUnpredictable that implements a
Constrained // Unpredictable behavior for a given Unpredictable
situation. // The behavior is within permitted behaviors for a given
Unpredictable situation, // these are documented in the textual part of
the architecture specification. // // This function is expected to be
refined in an IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED manner. // The details of possible
outcomes may not be present in the code and must be interpreted // for
each use with respect to the CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE specifications //
for the specific area. impdef func ConstrainUnpredictableProcedure(which
:</span>
[Unpredictable](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Unpredictable))
begin case which of when
[Unpredictable_PMUEVENTCOUNTER](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_PMUEVENTCOUNTER)
=\> Undefined(); when
[Unpredictable_MRC_APSR_TARGET](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Unpredictable_MRC_APSR_TARGET)
=\> PSTATE.\[N,Z,C,V\] = DBGDSCRint()\[31:28\]; otherwise =\>
ImpDef("IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED"); end; return; end;

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/vector/AdvSIMDExpandImm

<span id="shared.functions.vector.AdvSIMDExpandImm">//
AdvSIMDExpandImm() // ================== func</span>
<span id="func_AdvSIMDExpandImm_3">AdvSIMDExpandImm(op : bit, cmode :
bits(4), imm8 : bits(8)) =\> bits(64) begin var imm64 : bits(64); case
cmode\[3:1\] of when '000' =\> imm64 = Replicate{64}(Zeros{24}::imm8);
when '001' =\> imm64 = Replicate{64}(Zeros{16}::imm8::Zeros{8}); when
'010' =\> imm64 = Replicate{64}(Zeros{8}::imm8::Zeros{16}); when '011'
=\> imm64 = Replicate{64}(imm8::Zeros{24}); when '100' =\> imm64 =
Replicate{64}(Zeros{8}::imm8); when '101' =\> imm64 =
Replicate{64}(imm8::Zeros{8}); when '110' =\> if cmode\[0\] == '0' then
imm64 = Replicate{64}(Zeros{16}::imm8::Ones{8}); else imm64 =
Replicate{64}(Zeros{8}::imm8::Ones{16}); end; when '111' =\> if
cmode\[0\] == '0' && op == '0' then imm64 = Replicate{64}(imm8); end; if
cmode\[0\] == '0' && op == '1' then let imm8a : bits(8) =
Replicate{}(imm8\[7\]); let imm8b : bits(8) = Replicate{}(imm8\[6\]);
let imm8c : bits(8) = Replicate{}(imm8\[5\]); let imm8d : bits(8) =
Replicate{}(imm8\[4\]); let imm8e : bits(8) = Replicate{}(imm8\[3\]);

imm64 = imm8a::imm8b::imm8c::imm8d::imm8e::imm8f::imm8g::imm8h; end; if
cmode\[0\] == '1' && op == '0' then let imm32 : bits(32) =

imm8\[5:0\]::Zeros{19}); imm64 = Replicate{64}(imm32); end; if
cmode\[0\] == '1' && op == '1' then if</span>

<div class="ps">

<span id="shared.functions.vector.MatMulAdd"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/functions/vector/MatMulAdd

<span id="shared.functions.vector.MatMulAdd">// MatMulAdd() //
=========== // // Signed or unsigned 8-bit integer matrix multiply and
add to 32-bit integer matrix // result\[2, 2\] = addend\[2, 2\] +
(op1\[2, 8\] \* op2\[8, 2\]) func</span>
<span id="func_MatMulAdd_5">MatMulAdd(addend : bits(128), op1 :
bits(128), op2 : bits(128), op1_unsigned : boolean, op2_unsigned :
boolean) =\> bits(128) begin var result : bits(128); var sum : bits(32);
var prod : integer; for i = 0 to 1 do for j = 0 to 1 do sum =
addend\[(2\*i + j)\*:32\]; for k = 0 to 7 do let opelt1 : bits(8) =
op1\[(8\*i + k)\*:8\]; let opelt2 : bits(8) = op2\[(8\*j + k)\*:8\]; let
element1 : integer = if op1_unsigned then UInt(opelt1) else
SInt(opelt1); let element2 : integer = if op2_unsigned then UInt(opelt2)
else SInt(opelt2); prod = element1 \* element2; sum = sum + prod; end;
result\[(2\*i + j)\*:32\] = sum; end; end; return result; end;</span>

</div>

<span id="func_MatMulAdd_5"></span><span id="shared.functions.vector.PolynomialMult"></span>

<span id="shared.functions.vector.PolynomialMult">// PolynomialMult() //
================ func</span>
<span id="func_PolynomialMult_4">PolynomialMult{M, N}(op1 : bits(M), op2
: bits(N)) =\> bits(M+N) begin var result : bits(N + M) = Zeros{M+N};
let extended_op2 : bits(N + M) = ZeroExtend{M+N}(op2); for i=0 to M-1 do
if op1\[i\] == '1' then result = result XOR LSL(extended_op2, i); end;
end; return result; end;</span>

<span id="func_UnsignedRSqrtEstimate_2">UnsignedRSqrtEstimate{N}(operand
: bits(N)) =\> bits(N) begin assert N == 32; var result : bits(N); if
operand\[N-1:N-2\] == '00' then // Operands \<= 0x3FFFFFFF produce
0xFFFFFFFF result = Ones{N}; else // input is in the range 0x40000000 ..

<span id="func_UnsignedSatQ_2">UnsignedSatQ{N}(i : integer) =\>
(bits(N), boolean) begin var result : integer; var saturated : boolean;
if i \> 2^N - 1 then result = 2^N - 1; saturated = TRUE; elsif i \< 0
then result = 0; saturated = TRUE; else result = i; saturated = FALSE;
end; return (result\[N-1:0\], saturated); end;</span>

otherwise. // Otherwise, 'ec_bits' should be Zeros(). func</span>
<span id="func_ReportTRBEEvent_2">ReportTRBEEvent(ec_bits : bits(6),
fsc_bits : bits(6)) =\> bits(2) begin var target_el : bits(2); var

boolean = (ec_bits == '100100'); // Stage 1 fault let s2fault : boolean
= (ec_bits == '100101'); // Stage 2 fault var gpcfault, gpfault :
boolean; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME) then // Granule Protection
Check fault, other than GPF. That is, a GPT address size fault, // GPT
walk fault, or synchronous External abort on GPT fetch. gpcfault =
(ec_bits == '011110'); // Other Granule Protection Fault, reported as
Stage 1 or Stage 2 fault. gpfault = ((s1fault \|\| s2fault) && fsc_bits
IN {'10001x', '1001xx', '101000'}); else gpcfault = FALSE; gpfault =
FALSE; end; let sync_ext_abort : boolean = ((s1fault \|\| s2fault) &&
fsc_bits IN {'010000', '01001x', '0101xx', '011011'}); var owning_ss :
[SecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SecurityState);
var owning_el : bits(2); (owning_ss, owning_el) =
[TraceBufferOwner](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_TraceBufferOwner_0)();
if
[HaveEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HaveEL_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
&& MDCR_EL3().TRBEE == '1x' then route_to_el3 = (MDCR_EL3().TRBEE ==
'11' \|\| gpcfault \|\| (gpfault && SCR_EL3().GPF == '1') \|\|
(sync_ext_abort &&
[EffectiveEA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EffectiveEA_0)()
== '1')); end; if
[EffectiveTRFCR_EL2_EE](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EffectiveTRFCR_EL2_EE_0)()
== '1x' then route_to_el2 = (TRFCR_EL2().EE == '11' \|\| (s1fault &&
owning_el ==
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2))
\|\| s2fault \|\| gpcfault \|\| (gpfault && HCR_EL2().GPF == '1') \|\|
(sync_ext_abort &&
[EffectiveHCR_TEA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_EffectiveHCR_TEA_0)()
== '1')); end; end; if route_to_el3 then target_el =
[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3);
elsif route_to_el2 then target_el =
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2);
else target_el =

<span id="shared.translation.attrs.DecodeLDFAttr">// DecodeLDFAttr() //
=============== // Decode memory attributes using LDF (Long Descriptor
Format) mapping func</span>
<span id="func_DecodeLDFAttr_1">DecodeLDFAttr(attr : bits(4)) =\></span>
[MemAttrHints](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemAttrHints)
begin var ldfattr :
[MemAttrHints](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemAttrHints);
if attr == 'x0xx' then ldfattr.attrs =
[MemAttr_WT](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WT);
// Write-through elsif attr == '0100' then ldfattr.attrs =
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC);
// Non-cacheable elsif attr == 'x1xx' then ldfattr.attrs =
[MemAttr_WB](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_WB);
// Write-back else unreachable; end; // Allocation hints are applicable
only to cacheable memory. if ldfattr.attrs !=
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
then case attr\[1:0\] of when '00' =\> ldfattr.hints =
[MemHint_No](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_No);
// No allocation hints when '01' =\> ldfattr.hints =
[MemHint_WA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_WA);
// Write-allocate when '10' =\> ldfattr.hints =
[MemHint_RA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RA);
// Read-allocate when '11' =\> ldfattr.hints =
[MemHint_RWA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RWA);
// Read/Write allocate end; end; // The Transient hint applies only to
cacheable memory with some allocation hints. if ldfattr.attrs !=
[MemAttr_NC](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemAttr_NC)
&& ldfattr.hints !=
[MemHint_No](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_No)
then ldfattr.transient = attr\[3\] == '0'; end; return ldfattr; end;

</div>

<span id="shared.translation.attrs.DecodeSDFAttr">// DecodeSDFAttr() //

<span id="func_DecodeSDFAttr_1">DecodeSDFAttr(rgn : bits(2)) =\></span>
[MemAttrHints](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemAttrHints)
begin var sdfattr :
[MemAttrHints](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_MemAttrHints);
case rgn of when '00' =\> // Non-cacheable (no allocate) sdfattr.attrs =

when '01' =\> // Write-back, Read and Write allocate sdfattr.attrs =

sdfattr.hints =

when '11' =\> // Write-back, Read allocate sdfattr.attrs =

sdfattr.hints =
[MemHint_RA](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_MemHint_RA);

<span id="shared.translation.gpc.GPCRegistersConsistent"></span>

### Library pseudocode for shared/translation/gpc/GPCRegistersConsistent

<span id="shared.translation.gpc.GPCRegistersConsistent">//
GPCRegistersConsistent() // ======================== // Returns whether
the GPT registers are configured correctly. // This returns false if any
fields select a Reserved value. func</span>
<span id="func_GPCRegistersConsistent_0">GPCRegistersConsistent() =\>
boolean begin // Check for Reserved register values if
IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GPC3) then if ! GPCCR_EL3().\[PPS3, PPS\]
IN {'0xxx', '100x'} then return FALSE; end; if GPCCR_EL3().GPCBW == '1'
then if ! GPCBW_EL3().BWSIZE IN {'00x', '1x0', '010'} then return FALSE;
end; if
!</span>[GPCBW_EL3BWSTRIDEValid](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_GPCBW_EL3BWSTRIDEValid_0)()
then return FALSE; end; let bwstride : integer = 1 \<\< (40 +
UInt(GPCBW_EL3().BWSTRIDE)); let bwaddr : integer =
UInt(GPCBW_EL3().BWADDR) \<\< 30; if bwstride \<= bwaddr then return
FALSE; end; if !IsAlignedSize{26}(GPCBW_EL3().BWADDR, 1 \<\<
UInt(GPCBW_EL3().BWSIZE)) then return FALSE; end; end; else if
GPCCR_EL3().PPS == '111' then return FALSE; end; end; if
[DecodePPS](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_DecodePPS_0)()
\>
[AArch64_PAMax](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_AArch64_PAMax_0)()
then return FALSE; end; if GPCCR_EL3().PGS == '11' then return FALSE;
end; if GPCCR_EL3().SH == '01' then return FALSE; end; // Inner and
Outer Non-cacheable requires Outer Shareable if GPCCR_EL3().\[ORGN,
IRGN\] == '0000' && GPCCR_EL3().SH != '10' then return FALSE; end;
return TRUE; end;

</div>

<span id="shared.translation.gpc.GPICheck">// GPICheck() // ==========
// Returns whether an access to a given physical address space is
permitted // given the configured GPI value. // paspace: Physical
address space of the access // gpi: Value read from GPT for the access
// ss: Security state of the access func</span>
<span id="func_GPICheck_3">GPICheck(paspace :</span>
[PASpace](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PASpace),
gpi : bits(4), ss :
[SecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_SecurityState))
=\> boolean begin case gpi of when
[GPT_NoAccess](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NoAccess)
=\> return FALSE; when
[GPT_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Secure)
=\> assert IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SEL2); return paspace ==
[PAS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Secure);
when
[GPT_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NonSecure)
=\> return paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure);
when
[GPT_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Root)
=\> return paspace ==
[PAS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Root);
when
[GPT_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Realm)
=\> return paspace ==
[PAS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Realm);
when
[GPT_NonSecureOnly](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NonSecureOnly)
=\> assert IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GPC2); return paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure)
&& (ss IN
{[SS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Root),
[SS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_NonSecure)});
when
[GPT_SystemAgent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_SystemAgent)
=\> assert IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI); return paspace ==
[PAS_SystemAgent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_SystemAgent);
when
[GPT_NonSecureProtected](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NonSecureProtected)
=\> assert IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI); return paspace ==
[PAS_NonSecureProtected](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecureProtected);
when
[GPT_NA6](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NA6)
=\> assert IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI); return FALSE; when
[GPT_NA7](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NA7)
=\> assert IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI); return FALSE; when
[GPT_Any](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Any)
=\> return TRUE; otherwise =\> unreachable; end; end;

<span id="shared.translation.gpc.GPIValid">// GPIValid() // ==========
// Returns whether a given value is a valid encoding for a GPI value
func</span> <span id="func_GPIValid_1">GPIValid(gpi : bits(4)) =\>
boolean begin case gpi of when</span>
[GPT_NoAccess](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NoAccess)
=\> return TRUE; when
[GPT_NonSecureProtected](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NonSecureProtected)
=\> return IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI) && GPCCR_EL3().NSP == '1';
when
[GPT_SystemAgent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_SystemAgent)
=\> return IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI) && GPCCR_EL3().SA == '1';
when
[GPT_NA6](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NA6)
=\> return IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI) && GPCCR_EL3().NA6 == '1';
when
[GPT_NA7](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NA7)
=\> return IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GDI) && GPCCR_EL3().NA7 == '1';
when
[GPT_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Secure)
=\> return IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_SEL2); when
[GPT_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NonSecure)
=\> return TRUE; when
[GPT_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Realm)
=\> return TRUE; when
[GPT_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Root)
=\> return TRUE; when
[GPT_NonSecureOnly](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_NonSecureOnly)
=\> return IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME_GPC2) && GPCCR_EL3().NSO ==
'1'; when
[GPT_Any](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_GPT_Any)
=\> return TRUE; otherwise =\> return FALSE; end; end;

### Library pseudocode for shared/translation/vmsa/DecodePASpace

<span id="shared.translation.vmsa.DecodePASpace">// DecodePASpace() //
=============== // Decode the target PA Space func</span>
<span id="func_DecodePASpace_3">DecodePASpace(nse2 : bit, nse : bit, ns
: bit) =\></span>
[PASpace](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PASpace)
begin case nse2::nse::ns of when '000' =\> return
[PAS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Secure);
when '001' =\> return
[PAS_NonSecure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecure);
when '010' =\> return
[PAS_Root](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Root);
when '011' =\> return
[PAS_Realm](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_Realm);
when '100' =\> return
[PAS_SystemAgent](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_SystemAgent);
when '101' =\> return
[PAS_NonSecureProtected](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NonSecureProtected);
when '110' =\> return
[PAS_NA6](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NA6);
when '111' =\> return
[PAS_NA7](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_PAS_NA7);
otherwise =\> unreachable; end; end;

### Library pseudocode for shared/translation/vmsa/FetchDescriptor

<span id="shared.translation.vmsa.FetchDescriptor">// FetchDescriptor()
// ================= // Fetch a translation table descriptor func</span>
<span id="func_FetchDescriptor_5">FetchDescriptor{N : integer{32, 64,
128}}(ee : bit, walkaddress :</span>
[AddressDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressDescriptor),
walkaccess :
[AccessDescriptor](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AccessDescriptor),
fault_in :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord))
=\>
([FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord),
bits(N)) begin var descriptor : bits(N); var fault :
[FaultRecord](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_FaultRecord)
= fault_in; if IsFeatureImplemented(FEAT_RME) then fault.gpcf =
[GranuleProtectionCheck](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_GranuleProtectionCheck_2)(walkaddress,
walkaccess); if fault.gpcf.gpf !=
[GPCF_None](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_GPCF_None)
then fault.statuscode =
[Fault_GPCFOnWalk](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Fault_GPCFOnWalk);
fault.paddress = walkaddress.paddress; fault.gpcfs2walk =
fault.secondstage; return (fault, ARBITRARY : bits(N)); end; end; var
memstatus :
[PhysMemRetStatus](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_PhysMemRetStatus);
(memstatus, descriptor) =
[PhysMemRead](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_PhysMemRead_3){N}(walkaddress,
walkaccess); if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(memstatus)
then let iswrite : boolean = FALSE; fault =
[HandleExternalTTWAbort](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_HandleExternalTTWAbort_6)(memstatus,
iswrite, walkaddress, walkaccess, N DIV 8, fault); if
[IsFault](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_IsFault_1)(fault.statuscode)
then return (fault, ARBITRARY : bits(N)); end; end; if ee == '1' then
descriptor =
[BigEndianReverse](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_BigEndianReverse_2){N}(descriptor);
end; return (fault, descriptor); end;

</div>

<span id="shared.translation.vmsa.TranslationRegime">//

<span id="func_TranslationRegime_1">TranslationRegime(el : bits(2))
=\></span>
[Regime](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_Regime)
begin if el ==
[EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3)
then return if
[ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then
[Regime_EL30](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL30)
else
[Regime_EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL3);
elsif el ==
[EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2)
then return if
[ELIsInHost](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELIsInHost_1)([EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL2))
then
[Regime_EL20](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL20)
else
[Regime_EL2](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL2);
elsif el ==
[EL1](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL1)
then return
[Regime_EL10](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL10);
elsif el ==
[EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0)
then if
[CurrentSecurityState](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_CurrentSecurityState_0)()
==
[SS_Secure](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_SS_Secure)
&&
[ELUsingAArch32](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELUsingAArch32_1)([EL3](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL3))
then return
[Regime_EL30](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL30);
elsif
[ELIsInHost](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_ELIsInHost_1)([EL0](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_EL0))
then return
[Regime_EL20](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL20);
else return
[Regime_EL10](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#enum_Regime_EL10);
end; else unreachable; end; end;

<span id="shared.translation.vmsa.TranslationSize">// TranslationSize()
// ================= // Compute the number of bits directly mapped from
the input address // to the output address func</span>
<span id="func_TranslationSize_3">TranslationSize(d128 : bit, tgx
:</span>
[TGx](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_TGx),

begin let granulebits :
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize)
=
[TGxGranuleBits](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#func_TGxGranuleBits_1)(tgx);
let descsizelog2 : integer{} = if d128 == '1' then 4 else 3; let
blockbits : integer =
([FINAL_LEVEL](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#global_FINAL_LEVEL) -
level) \* (granulebits - descsizelog2); return (granulebits + blockbits)
as
[AddressSize](https://www.scs.stanford.edu/~zyedidia/arm64/shared_pseudocode.html#type_AddressSize);
end;
